注

  • 方向标志 \(DF\) : \(DF=0\) 时 \(SI/DI\) 递增;\(DF=1\) 时\(SI/DI\)递减. 可用 \(CLD\)清零、\(STD\) 置位.
  • 段寄存器 : 源默认 \(DS:SI\)，目的默认 \(ES:DI\). 可通过覆盖前缀改变段.
  • 重复前缀 : \(REP\) 适用于 \(MOVS\)/\(LODS\)/\(STOS\); \(REPE\)/\(REPNE\) 主要配合 \(CMPS\)/\(SCAS\)，满足条件且 \(CX\ne0\) 才继续.

3.3.5 控制转移指令

用于 改变程序执行流程 ( 跳转, 循环, 调用/返回 ) :

指令语法示例类型/范围标志位条件/影响备注
\(JMP\) \(SHORT\)\(JMP\) \(SHORT\) \(label\)段内短相对 ( \(disp8\) )无影响\(CS\) 不变
\(JMP\) \(NEAR\)\(JMP\) \(NEAR\) \(PTR\) \(label\)段内近相对 ( \(disp16\) )无影响\(CS\) 不变
\(JMP\) \(FAR\)\(JMP\) \(FAR\) \(PTR\) \(2000\mathrm{H}:0100\mathrm{H}\)段间远绝对 ( \(m16:16\) )无影响更新 \(CS:IP\)
\(JMP\) 间接近\(JMP\) \(WORD\) \(PTR\) \([ SI]\)段内近间接 ( \(r/m16\) )无影响\(CS\) 不变
\(JMP\) 间接远\(JMP\) \(DWORD\) \(PTR\) \([ BX]\)段间远间接 ( \(m16:16\) )无影响更新 \(CS:IP\)
\(Jcc\)\(JZ\)/\(JNZ\)/\(JC\)/\(JNC\) … \(label\)段内短相对 ( \(disp8\) )依条件标志仅短跳
\(LOOP\)\(LOOP\) \(label\)段内短相对 ( \(disp8\) )\(CX-1 \ne 0\) 则跳转仅短跳
\(LOOPE\)/\(REPZ\)\(LOOPE\) \(label\)段内短相对 ( \(disp8\) )\(CX-1 \ne 0\) 且 \(ZF=1\)仅短跳
\(LOOPNE\)/\(REPNZ\)\(LOOPNE\) \(label\)段内短相对 ( \(disp8\) )\(CX-1 \ne 0\) 且 \(ZF=0\)仅短跳
\(CALL\) 近\(CALL\) \(NEAR\) \(label\)段内近调用无影响压栈返回偏移 \(IP\)
\(CALL\) 远\(CALL\) \(FAR\) \(1234\mathrm{H}:0000\mathrm{H}\)段间远调用无影响压栈 \(CS:IP\)
\(RET\)\(RET\)段内返回无影响弹出 \(IP\); 可带立即数
\(RETF\)\(RETF\)段间返回无影响弹出 \(IP\) 和 \(CS\)
\(INT\)\(INT\) \(n\)软件中断无影响压栈 \(FLAGS\)/\(CS\)/\(IP\); 转向向量
\(IRET\)\(IRET\)中断返回恢复 \(FLAGS\)弹出 \(IP\)/\(CS\)/\(FLAGS\)

注

  • 范围 : \(Jcc\) 与 \(LOOP\) 仅支持 \(disp8\); \(JMP\) 支持短/近/远;跨段需使用远跳或远调用.
  • 近/远 : 近跳/近调不改变 \(CS\);远跳/远调会更新 \(CS:IP\).
  • 指针大小 : 段内间接用 \(WORD\PTR\); 段间间接用 \(DWORD\PTR\); \(NEAR\ PTR\)/\(FAR\ PTR\) 可用于强制类型.
  • \(m16\)\(16\)表示内存中的远指针 ( 连续 \(4\) 字节 )：低 \(2\) 字节为偏移，高 \(2\) 字节为段; 8086 为小端存储 (低地址存低字节 ). 例如 : \(JMP\) \(DWORD\) \(PTR\) [ \(BX\) ] 从 [ \(BX\) ] 取偏移、从 [ \(BX+2\) ] 取段，更新 \(IP\) 与 \(CS\); \(JMP\) \(FAR\) \(PTR\) \(2000\mathrm{H}:0100\mathrm{H}\) 为立即给出段 偏移常量.
  • \(r\) /\(m16\) 表示寄存器/内存 \(16\) 位操作数 ( \(ModR/M\) ) ：可为寄存器 \(r16\) ( 如 \(AX\)/\(BX\)/\(CX\)/\(DX\)… ) 或内存 \(m16\) ( 如 \(WORD\ PTR\) [ \(SI\) ], \(WORD\PTR\) [ \(BX+DI+disp\) ] ).段默认 : \(BX\)/\(SI\)/\(DI\) 用 \(DS\), \(BP\) 用 \(SS\); 可用段覆盖前缀更改.

ʚ 示例 ɞ 控制转移指令典型用法 ( \(JMP\)/\(Jcc\)/\(LOOP\)/\(CALL\)/\(RET\)/\(INT\) )

3.3.6 处理机控制与杂项操作指令

用于 控制 \(CPU\) 状态与标志位 :

指令语法示例核心功能标志位影响备注
\(CLC\)\(CLC\)清进位标志\(CF \leftarrow 0\)其他标志不变
\(STC\)\(STC\)置进位标志\(CF \leftarrow 1\)其他标志不变
\(CMC\)\(CMC\)取反进位标志\(CF \leftarrow \neg CF\)其他标志不变
\(CLD\)\(CLD\)清方向标志\(DF \leftarrow 0\)串指令 \(SI/DI\) 自增
\(STD\)\(STD\)置方向标志\(DF \leftarrow 1\)串指令 \(SI/DI\) 自减
\(CLI\)\(CLI\)清中断标志\(IF \leftarrow 0\)禁用可屏蔽中断
\(STI\)\(STI\)置中断标志\(IF \leftarrow 1\)允许可屏蔽中断
\(PUSHF\)\(PUSHF\)压栈标志寄存器无直接影响栈顶入 \(FLAGS\)
\(POPF\)\(POPF\)弹栈到标志寄存器恢复各标志从栈取回 \(FLAGS\)
\(HLT\)\(HLT\)处理器暂停无影响等待中断/复位唤醒
\(NOP\)\(NOP\)空操作无影响对齐/占位，1 字节
\(WAIT\)\(WAIT\)等待外部测试引脚无影响与协处理器/外设同步
\(ESC\)\(ESC\) \(opcode\), \(r/m\)逃逸到协处理器无影响将操作码/数据交给协处理器

注

  • \(DF\) 影响串指令指针增减; 可用\(CLD\)/\(STD\) 显式控制.
  • \(IF\) 控制可屏蔽中断响应; \(CLI\) 禁止、\(STI\) 允许.
  • \(HLT\) 进入低功耗等待;遇中断或复位恢复执行.
  • \(PUSHF\)/\(POPF\) 常与中断管理、特权切换配合使用.

entry.title: 汇编-2-80x86计算机组织
entry.content:
知识点速览

80x86实模式寻址&寄存器核心速查表
分类细分规则 / 说明示例
8086 寄存器数据寄存器AX ( 累加 / IO / 乘除 ),BX ( 基址 ), CX ( 计数 ),DX ( 数据 / IO端口 ).MUL BL ( 隐含 AX )
指针/变址SP ( 栈顶 ),BP ( 栈底 ), SI ( 源变址 ),DI ( 目的变址 ).MOV AX, [SI]
段寄存器CS ( 代码 ),DS ( 数据 ), SS ( 堆栈 ),ES ( 附加 ).MOV AX, ES:[BX]
控制寄存器IP ( 指令指针 ),FLAGS ( 状态标志 CF/ZF/SF/OF… 控制标志 DF/IF… ).JZ Label ( 查 ZF )
寻址方式立即寻址操作数包含在指令中 ( 立即数 ).MOV AX, 1234H
寄存器寻址操作数在寄存器中.MOV AX, BX
直接寻址指令直接给出有效地址 ( EA ).MOV AX, [2000H]
寄存器间接EA 存放在 BX,BP, SI, DI 中.MOV AX, [BX]
寄存器相对EA = 寄存器内容 + 位移量 ( 8/16位 ).MOV AX, [BX+10H]
基址变址EA = 基址 ( BX/BP ) +变址 ( SI/DI ).MOV AX, [BX+SI]
相对基址变址EA = 基址 + 变址 + 位移量.MOV AX, [BX+SI+10H]
实模式地址物理地址\(\text{物理地址} = \text{段地址} \times 16 +\text{偏移地址}\) ( EA ).\(2000\mathrm{H}:0100\mathrm{H} \to20100\mathrm{H}\)
默认段搭配CS IP ( 指令 ),SS SP/BP ( 栈 ), DS BX/SI/DI ( 数据).MOV [BP], AX ( 默认 SS )

第2章80x86计算机组织汇编笔记

2.1 80x86微处理器

  • 定义 : 80x86 是 \(Intel\)推出的系列微处理器 ( 如 \(8086\)、\(80286\)、\(80386\)… )，是 \(x86\) 架构的基础，支持 \(16/32\) 位指令系统，是早期 \(PC\) 的核心运算部件.
  • 核心特点
    1. 向下兼容 : 新处理器支持旧型号的指令集;
    2. 分代演进 : 从 \(16\) 位 ( \(8086\) ) \(\to\) \(32\) 位 ( \(80386\))，逐步扩展地址总线、寄存器位数.

2.2基于微处理器的计算机系统构成

2.2.1 硬件

  • 核心组成 :

    1. 微处理器 运算与控制核心;
    2. 存储器 存放 数据 和指令 ( 内存、缓存 );
    3. 总线 连接各硬件的通信线路 (地址总线、数据总线、控制总线);
    4. 外部设备 输入 ( 键盘)、输出 ( 显示器 )、存储 ( 硬盘)…设备.

  • 关系 :微处理器通过总线访问存储器和外设，实现数据/指令的传输与处理.

  • 总线详解 :

    • 地址总线 决定可寻址空间大小，位宽为 \(n\) 则可寻址 \(2^n\) 个地址.
    • 数据总线 一次可并行传输的位数，位宽为 \(m\) 则一次传输 \(m\) 位数据.
    • 控制总线 承载读写控制、中断请求、总线仲裁…控制信号.

  • 示例 : \(8086\) 的地址总线为\(20\) 位，可寻址 \(1\) \(MB\)空间; 数据总线为 \(16\) 位，一次传输\(16\) 位数据.

2.2.2 软件

  • 分类 :
    1. 系统软件 操作系统 ( 如 \(DOS\))、汇编器、编译器…，管理硬件资源.
    2. 应用软件 基于系统软件运行的程序 ( 如 文本编辑器).
  • 与硬件的交互 :软件的指令通过微处理器翻译成硬件可执行的电信号，完成运算或外设控制.

2.2.3 指令与伪指令对比

项目定义 / 作用处理者是否生成机器码示例发生阶段 / 结果
伪指令指导汇编器的编译行为 ( 数据定义、对齐、定位、结束 )汇编器否 ( 本身无操作码 ，可能生成数据字节 )\(DB\) / \(DW\) / \(ORG\) / \(END\)编译阶段 影响目标文件布局或生成常量数据
真实指令\(CPU\) 可执行的机器指令 (运算、传送、跳转、端口 \(I/O\) )\(CPU\)是 ( 生成操作码 + 操作数 )\(MOV\) / \(ADD\) / \(JMP\) / \(IN\) / \(OUT\)运行阶段 取指 \(→\) 译码 \(→\) 执行 ，更新寄存器 / \(FLAGS\)
汇编器处理伪指令解析 / 展开伪指令 ，分配地址 ，生成常量数据 ，调整段位置汇编器伪指令不生成操作码 ，但可能生成数据字节处理 \(DB\) 产生数据字节; \(ORG\) 调整当前位置; \(END\) 终止编译编译阶段 形成可链接的目标文件
\(CPU\) 执行指令按操作码与寻址方式执行 ，进行算术 / 逻辑 / 传送 / 控制\(CPU\)已生成 ( 指令码 )执行 \(MOV\) / \(ADD\) / \(JMP\) / \(IN\) / \(OUT\)运行阶段 对数据与状态产生实际影响

2.3 中央处理机 ( CPU )

2.3.1 中央处理机CPU的组成

  • 核心模块 :
    1. 运算器 ( \(ALU\) )执行 算术运算 ( 加/减 )、逻辑运算 (与/或 ).
    2. 控制器 解析指令、生成控制信号，协调 硬件时序;
    3. 寄存器组 临时 存储数据/地址/指令，提升运算效率( 80x86 的核心寄存器见 \(2.3.2\)).
  • 典型数据通路 :
    • 取指 \(CS:IP\)指向 下一条指令，取到指令字节送入指令队列.
    • 译码 控制器解析 操作码 与寻址方式，产生执行所需 控制信号.
    • 执行 \(ALU\)完成算术/逻辑运算，结果写回寄存器或内存，对应标志位在 \(FLAGS\) 中更新.

2.3.2 80x86寄存器组

80x86 的寄存器按功能分为 \(4\) 类 (以 \(8086\) 为例，\(16\) 位寄存器 ).

  1. 通用寄存器 ( \(8\)个 ).
    • 数据寄存器 \(AX\) ( 累加器 )，\(BX\) ( 基址寄存器 )，\(CX\) ( 计数寄存器 )，\(DX\) ( 数据寄存器 ).
    • 指针/变址寄存器 \(SP\) ( 栈指针 )，\(BP\) ( 基址指针 )，\(SI\) ( 源变址 )，\(DI\) ( 目的变址 ).
    • 典型寻址组合 有效地址 \(EA\) 可由 \(BX\)/\(BP\) 与 \(SI\)/\(DI\) 以及 位移构成，如 \(EA = BX + SI + disp\) 或\(EA = BP + DI + disp\).
  • 示例 : \(DS:BX +SI\) 指向 数据区，\(SS:BP + DI\) 指向栈区.

注

\(AX\)累加器 ，用于 算术 / 逻辑运算 ;下表总结乘除指令的 隐含寄存器 ; 串加载 \(LODSB\) / \(LODSW\) 使用 \(AL\) / \(AX\) .

指令源位宽输入结果
\(MUL\) /\(IMUL\)\(8\)位\(AL\times\) 源\(AX\)
\(MUL\) /\(IMUL\)\(16\)位\(AX\times\) 源\(DX:AX\)
\(DIV\) /\(IDIV\)\(8\)位\(AX\div\) 源商 \(AL\)，余数 \(AH\)
\(DIV\) /\(IDIV\)\(16\)位\(DX:AX\div\) 源商 \(AX\)，余数 \(DX\)

\(CX\)计数寄存器 ，用于 循环 / 重复前缀 计数( \(LOOP\) /\(LOOPE\) /\(REP\) );移位 / 旋转 位数由 \(CL\) 指定.

\(DX\)数据寄存器 ，与 \(AX\)组成 \(DX:AX\) 用于乘除拓展; 端口号寄存器 ( 变址端口 \(IN\) / \(OUT\) 使用 \(DX\) 指定端口 ).

\(SP\)栈指针 ，指向 栈顶; 受 \(PUSH\) / \(POP\) 影响 ( \(SP = SP - 2\) / \(SP = SP + 2\) ).

\(AH\) /\(AL\) \(AX\) 的 高 / 低字节;常用于 \(DOS\) 中断功能号 ( 如 \(INT21H\) 的 \(AH\) ) 与字符 \(I/O\) ( 使用\(AL\) ).

  1. 段寄存器 ( \(4\)个 ).
    • \(CS\) ( 代码段)，\(DS\) ( 数据段)，\(SS\) ( 栈段)，\(ES\) ( 附加段)，用于存储器 分段寻址.
  2. 控制寄存器
    • \(IP\) ( 指令指针) : 存放 下一条 要执行的指令地址.
    • \(FLAGS\) (标志寄存器 ) : 记录 运算结果状态 ( 如 零标志 \(ZF\)，进位标志 \(CF\) ).

  • 标志位详解 (表格) :

    标志位作用典型置位示例常见影响指令
    \(CF\)无符号进位/借位\(8\) 位\(255+2\) \(→\) \(CF=1\); 减法借位置 \(1\)\(ADD\)/\(ADC\)/\(SUB\)/\(SBB\)/\(SHL\)/\(SHR\)/\(RCL\)/\(RCR\)
    \(ZF\)结果为 \(0\)\(5-5\)\(→\) \(ZF=1\); 比较相等\(CMP\)/\(TEST\)/逻辑/移位，\(JZ\)/\(JNZ\)
    \(SF\)结果符号 (最高位)结果最高位为 \(1\) \(→\)\(SF=1\)算术/逻辑，\(JS\)/\(JNS\)
    \(OF\)有符号 溢出\(127+1\)(\(8\) 位) \(→\) \(OF=1\)算术/移位，\(JO\)/\(JNO\)
    \(PF\)低 \(8\)位 奇偶 (偶为 \(1\))低 \(8\)位中 \(1\) 的个数为偶数 \(→\) \(PF=1\)逻辑/\(TEST\)
    \(AF\)低 \(4\)位 进/借位\(BCD\)调整触发\(DAA\)/\(DAS\)/\(AAA\)/\(AAS\)
    \(DF\)串方向控制\(STD\)\(→\) \(DF=1\) 自减; \(CLD\) \(→\) \(DF=0\) 自增\(MOVS\)/\(CMPS\)/\(SCAS\)/\(LODS\)/\(STOS\)/\(REP\)
    \(IF\)中断允许\(STI\)\(→\) \(IF=1\); \(CLI\) \(→\) \(IF=0\)允许可屏蔽中断
    \(TF\)单步陷阱\(TF=1\)每条指令后触发 \(INT\) \(1\)调试/单步

2.4 存储器

2.4.1 存储单元的地址和内容

  • 存储单元 存储器的基本单位 ( \(8\) 位 \(=1\) 字节 )，每个单元对应 唯一 的地址 ( 由地址总线编码 ).
  • 地址与内容 :
    • 地址 标识存储单元的 编号 ( 如\(8086\) 的地址总线为 \(20\) 位，可寻址 \(1\) \(MB\)空间，地址范围 \(00000\mathrm{H} \simFFFFF\mathrm{H}\) ).
    • 内容 存储单元中存放的 \(8\) 位 二进制 数据 ( 如 地址 \(1234H\) 的 内容 可能 是\(5AH\) ).

2.4.2 实模式存储器寻址

  • 定义 : 80x86 的 \(16\) 位工作模式 (如 \(8086\) 默认模式 )，通过段地址 + 偏移地址 组合寻址.
  • 寻址公式 \[\text{物理地址} = \text{段地址} \times 16 +\text{偏移地址}\]
  • 示例 : 段地址 \(1000\mathrm{H}\) + 偏移地址\(2000\mathrm{H}\)\(→\) 物理地址 =\(1000\mathrm{H} \times 16 +2000\mathrm{H} = 12000\mathrm{H}\).
    • 特点 段地址由 段寄存器 提供，偏移地址由通用寄存器 / \(IP\)提供，最大寻址 \(1\) \(MB\).

注

可用于形成偏移地址的寄存器 : \(BX\)/ \(SI\) / \(DI\) / \(BP\).

默认段寄存器 : \(BX\) / \(SI\) / \(DI\) \(→\)\(DS\); \(BP\) \(→\)\(SS\).

常见地址表达式 : [ \(BX\) ] , [\(SI\) ] , [ \(DI\) ] , [ \(BP\) ] , [ \(BX +SI\) ] , [ \(BX + DI\) ] , [\(BP + SI\) ] , [ \(BP + DI\) ] , [ \(disp\) ] , [ \(reg + disp\) ].

\(BX\)基址寄存器 , 默认搭配 \(DS\); 用于数据区间接寻址 与 基址 + 变址组合 ( 如[ \(BX\) ] , [ \(BX + SI\) ] , [ \(BX + DI\) ] , [ \(BX + disp\) ] ).

\(BP\)基址指针 , 默认搭配 \(SS\); 用于 栈帧 /局部变量寻址 , 亦可 与变址寄存器组合 ( 如 [\(BP\) ] , [ \(BP + SI\) ] , [ \(BP + DI\) ] , [ \(BP + disp\) ] ).

\(SI\)源变址 , 默认搭配 \(DS\); 串处理指令的 源地址默认 \(DS:SI\) ( 如 \(MOVSB\) / \(LODSB\) ) ,亦可作一般间接寻址.

\(DI\)目的变址 , 一般间接寻址默认搭配 \(DS\); 串处理指令的 目的地址默认 \(ES:DI\) ( 如 \(MOVSB\) / \(STOSB\) ).

\(IP\)指令指针 , 与 \(CS\) 组合给出指令地址; 不用于一般数据寻址.

  • 段重叠与环绕 :
    • 多段可指向同一物理区域，如 \(1000\mathrm{H}:0200\mathrm{H}\) 与 \(0FF0\mathrm{H}:0300\mathrm{H}\)的物理地址可能重叠.
    • \(A20\) 地址线 : 早期系统关闭 \(A20\) 时，超过 \(1\) \(MB\)的地址按 \(1\) \(MB\) 取模环绕，即 \(\text{PA} = \text{PA} \bmod 2^{20}\).
    • 栈示例 : \(SS:SP\) 指向栈顶，\(PUSH\) 先将 \(SP\) 减 \(2\)，再写入数据; \(POP\) 先读出数据，再将 \(SP\) 加 \(2\).

2.4.3 保护模式存储器寻址

  • 定义 : \(80286\) 及以上处理器的\(32\)位工作模式，支持多任务、内存保护，寻址范围扩展至 \(4\) \(GB\).

  • 核心机制 :

    1. 段寄存器存 段选择子 ，指向 内存中的 段描述符 ( 记录段的 基址、长度 、权限 ).
    2. 物理地址 \(=\)段描述符 中的 基址 \(+\) 偏移地址.

  • 特点 支持内存权限检查 ( 如只读段不可写 )，适合多任务操作系统 ( 如\(Windows\) ).

  • 关键结构与字段 :

    • 段选择子 \(Selector\) : 由 索引 \(Index\) + 表标志 \(TI\) ( \(0\) 为 \(GDT\) , \(1\) 为 \(LDT\) ) + 请求者特权级\(RPL\) 组成.
    • 全局描述符表 \(GDT\) / 局部描述符表 \(LDT\) : 存放 段描述符\(Descriptor\).
    • 段描述符 包含 段基址 \(Base\) 、段界限 \(Limit\) 、访问权限 \(Access\) 与 标志位 \(Flags\) ( 如 \(DPL\) , \(Present\) , \(Granularity\) ).
    • 线性地址计算 \(\text{Linear} = \text{Base} +\text{Offset}\) ，当启用 分页 ( \(Paging\) ) 时 , 线性地址再经 页表 转换为 物理地址.
    • 特权级 \(Ring\) :\(0\) ( 内核 ) 至 \(3\) ( 用户 )四级，指令与数据访问需满足特权检查.
    • 使能保护模式 置位 控制寄存器 \(CR0\) 的 \(PE\) 位 为 \(1\) ，切换到保护模式.

  • 示例 \(CS\)载入 选择子 指向 \(GDT\) 中 代码段描述符，从而确立 代码段 的 \(Base\) / \(Limit\) 与 权限.

2.4.4 存储器中数据的存放方式

  • 基本单位 : 字节 ( \(8\) 位 ) 、字 (\(16\) 位 ) 、双字 ( \(32\) 位 ).
  • 字节序 : 80x86 采用 小端序 ( Little-Endian )，规则为 ” 低位字节存放在低地址 “.
    • 示例 ( 字 ) : 在地址 \(1000\mathrm{H}\) 开始存放\(1234\mathrm{H}\)\(→\) [ \(1000\mathrm{H}\) ] = \(34\mathrm{H}\) ，[ \(1001\mathrm{H}\) ] = \(12\mathrm{H}\).
    • 示例 ( 双字 ) : 在地址 \(2000\mathrm{H}\) 开始存放\(12345678\mathrm{H}\)\(→\) [ \(2000\mathrm{H}\) ] = \(78\mathrm{H}\) ，[ \(2001\mathrm{H}\) ] = \(56\mathrm{H}\) ，[ \(2002\mathrm{H}\) ] = \(34\mathrm{H}\) ，[ \(2003\mathrm{H}\) ] = \(12\mathrm{H}\).
  • 栈的存放方向 : 栈向 低地址 增长 ( \(PUSH\) 时 \(SP=SP-2\) ，\(POP\) 时 \(SP=SP+2\) ) ，栈内数据按小端序 存放.
    • 示例 : \(PUSH\) \(1234\mathrm{H}\) 后 \(→\) [ \(SS:SP\) ] = \(34\mathrm{H}\) ，[ \(SS:SP+1\) ] = \(12\mathrm{H}\).
  • 字符与字符串 : 字符以 \(ASCII\) 按字节顺序存放;字符串在内存中 连续 存放 , 常见以 \(00\mathrm{H}\) 或$ 作为结束标记 ( 与 \(DOS\) 功能调用相关 ).
  • 数据对齐 : 在 \(8086\) 上 , 字 /双字 不强制对齐; 较新处理器在按类型对齐 时通常具有更好的性能.
  • 结构与数组 : 数据按 声明顺序 连续存放;数组元素相邻存放.
    • 示例 : 在地址 \(3000\mathrm{H}\) 开始存放字节数组\(11\mathrm{H}\) ,\(22\mathrm{H}\) ,\(33\mathrm{H}\) \(→\) [ \(3000\mathrm{H}\) ] = \(11\mathrm{H}\) ，[ \(3001\mathrm{H}\) ] = \(22\mathrm{H}\) ，[ \(3002\mathrm{H}\) ] = \(33\mathrm{H}\).
  • 说明 : 逻辑地址可写作 段 : 偏移 ( 如 \(DS:BX\) ); 对应物理地址 计算为 段地址 × \(16\) + 偏移地址.

2.5 外部设备

  • 定义 : 连接在计算机外部的硬件，分为输入设备 ( 键盘、鼠标)、输出设备 ( 显示器、打印机 )、存储设备 ( 硬盘、U盘 )….

  • 与 \(CPU\) 的交互 : 通过接口电路 ( 如 \(I/O\)端口 ) 与 \(CPU\) 通信，\(CPU\) 通过读写 \(I/O\) 端口的指令 ( 如 \(IN/OUT\) ) 控制外设.

  • \(I/O\) 端口与指令 :

    • 端口寻址 : \(8\) 位或 \(16\) 位端口号，常用指令 \(IN\) / \(OUT\) 访问.
    • 字符串 \(I/O\) : \(INS\) / \(OUTS\) 支持批量端口读写，配合 \(DX\) 指定端口，\(DI\) / \(SI\) 指向缓冲区，\(CX\) 为计数.
    • 中断与外设 : 外设通过中断控制器请求 \(CPU\) ，常见 \(PIC\) / \(APIC\) 结构用于管理中断.

entry.title: 汇编-1-基础知识
entry.content:
知识点速览

第1章基础知识核心公式&运算示例速查表

类别规则 / 公式示例
进制转换\(\sum( ext{位值} imes 2^{n-1})\).\(1011_2 o 1 imes 2^3 + 0 imes 2^2 + 1 imes 2^1 + 1 imes 2^0 =11_{10}\).
进制转换整数 : 除 \(2\) 取余 , 逆序排列.\(13_{10} o1101_2\).
进制转换小数 : 乘 \(2\) 取整 , 顺序排列.\(0.625_{10} o0.101_2\).
进制转换十六进制 \(1\) 位 \( o\) 二进制 \(4\) 位 ( 不足补 \(0\) ).\(3A_{16} o00111010_2\).
进制转换二进制每 \(4\) 位分组 \( o\) 十六进制 \(1\) 位.\(1101011_2 o0110\ 1011 o 6B_{16}\).
进制转换\(\sum( ext{位值} imes 16^{n-1})\).\(2F_{16} o 2 imes 16^1 + 15 imes 16^0 = 47_{10}\).
补码表示正数 : 原码 ( 符号位 \(0\) + 数值位 ).\(5_{10}\) ( \(8\) 位 ) \( o00000101\).
补码表示负数 : 原码取反 ( 符号位不变 ) + \(1\).\(-5_{10}\) ( \(8\) 位 ) \( o10000101\) ( 原 ) \( o11111011\) ( 补 ).
补码运算\([X+Y]_{ ext{补}} = [X]_{ ext{补}} +[Y]_{ ext{补}}\).\(5 + ( -3 ) o00000101 + 11111101 = 100000010 o 00000010\) ( 补 ) \( o 2_{10}\).
补码运算\([X-Y]_{ ext{补}} = [X]_{ ext{补}} +[-Y]_{ ext{补}}\).\(5 - 3 o00000101 + 11111101 = 00000010 o 2_{10}\).
逻辑运算与 : 全 \(1\) 则 \(1\) , 有 \(0\) 则 \(0\).\(1011 \ \&\ 0101 = 0001\).
逻辑运算或 : 有 \(1\) 则 \(1\) , 全 \(0\) 则 \(0\).\(1011 \ | \0101 = 1111\).
逻辑运算非 : 位取反.\(\sim1011\) ( \(4\) 位 ) \(= 0100\).
逻辑运算异或 : 相同则 \(0\) , 不同则 \(1\).\(1011 \ ^ \0101 = 1110\).
范围表示\(n\)位无符号整数 : \(0 \sim 2^n - 1\).\(8\) 位\( o 0 \sim 255\).

字 / 字节 / 双字换算表

名称位数 (bit)字节数 (Byte)换算关系
位 (Bit)11/8最小信息单位 (0 或 1)
字节 (Byte)81基本存储单位
字 (Word)1621 字 = 2 字节
双字 (Double Word)3241 双字 = 4 字节 = 2 字
四字 (Quad Word)6481 四字 = 8 字节 = 4 字
十字节 (Ten Bytes)80101 十字节 = 10 字节 ( 浮点数 )
节 (Paragraph)128161 节 = 16 字节 ( 段对齐单位 )

计算机基础知识汇编笔记

第1章 基础知识

1.1进位记数制与不同基数的数之间的转换

1.1.1 二进制数

  • 定义 ：以 \(2\)为基数的记数制，仅用 \(0\) 和 \(1\) 表示，运算规则为”逢 \(2\) 进 \(1\)“.
  • 位权 ：第 \(n\)位的位权为 \(2^{n-1}\) ( 从右往左，从\(0\) 开始计数 ).
  • 示例 ：二进制数 \(1011\) 的位权展开 ： \[ 1 imes 2^3 + 0 imes 2^2 + 1 imes 2^1 +1 imes 2^0 = 11 ext{ ( 十进制 ) } \]

1.1.2二进制数和十进制数之间的转换

  • 二进制转十进制 ：按位权展开求和 ( 如上示例 ).
  • 十进制转二进制 ：
    1. 整数部分 ：“除 \(2\) 取余，逆序排列”
      • 示例 ：十进制 13 转二进制 ： \(13\div 2=6 \dots 1 o 6\div 2=3 \dots 0 o 3\div2=1 \dots 1 o 1\div 2=0 \dots 1\) 结果：1101
    2. 小数部分 ：“乘 \(2\) 取整，顺序排列”
      • 示例 ：十进制 0.625 转二进制 ： \(0.625 imes 2=1.25 ext{ 取1} o 0.25 imes2=0.5 ext{ 取0} o 0.5 imes 2=1.0 ext{ 取1}\) 结果：0.101

1.1.3十六进制数及其与二进制、十进制数之间的转换

  • 十六进制数 ：以 \(16\) 为基数，用 \(0\)-\(9\)、\(A\)-\(F\) ( \(A\) = \(10\), \(F\) = \(15\) ) 表示，“逢 \(16\) 进 $1”.
  • 十六进制转二进制 ：每 \(1\) 位 十六进制 对应 \(4\) 位 二进制 ( 不足补 \(0\) ).
    • 示例 ：\(3A\) (十六进制 ) \( o\) \(0011\ 1010\) ( 二进制 )
  • 二进制转十六进制 ：从右往左每 \(4\) 位分组，不足补 \(0\) ，每组对应 \(1\) 位十六进制.
    • 示例 ：\(1101011\)( 二进制 ) \( o\) 分组 \(0110\ 1011\) \( o\) \(6B\) ( 十六进制 )
  • 十六进制转十进制 ：按位权展开 ( 位权为 \(16^{n-1}\) ).
    • 示例 ：\(2F\) (十六进制 ) \( o 2 imes 16^1 + 15 imes 16^0= 47\) ( 十进制 )

1.2 二进制数和十六进制数运算

1.2.1 二进制数运算

  • 加法 ：\(0+0=0; 0+1=1;1+1=10\) ( 进 \(1\) )
    • 示例 ：\(1011 + 0101 =10000\)
  • 减法 ：\(0-0=0; 1-0=1;1-1=0; 0-1=1\) ( 借 \(1\) 当\(2\) )
    • 示例 ：\(1000 - 0101 =0011\)
  • 乘法 ：类似十进制，“位乘+移位相加”
    • 示例 ：\(101 imes 11 = 101 imes 1 +101 imes 10 = 101 + 1010 = 1111\)
  • 除法 ：类似十进制，“试商+减法”
    • 示例 ：\(1111 \div 101 = 11 ext{ ( 商 )} \dots 0 ext{ ( 余 ) }\)

1.2.2 十六进制数运算

  • 规则：“逢16进1，借1当16”，运算时可先转二进制计算，再转回十六进制.
  • 示例 ：\(3A +15\) ( 十六进制 ) \( o\) 转二进制 \(00111010 + 00010101 = 01001111\)\( o\) 转十六进制 \(4F\)

1.3 计算机中数和字符的表示

1.3.1 数的补码表示

  • 背景：计算机用补码统一表示正负数，简化减法为加法.
  • 正数的补码 ：与原码 ( 符号位 \(0\) + 数值位 ) 相同.
    • 示例 ：十进制 5 ( 8位 ) \( o\) 原码 00000101 \( o\) 补码 00000101
  • 负数的补码 ：原码 ( 符号位 \(1\) + 数值位 ) 取反 ( 符号位不变 ) 后加\(1\).
    • 示例 ：十进制 -5 ( \(8\) 位 ) \( o\) 原码 10000101 \( o\) 反码 11111010 \( o\) 补码 11111011

1.3.2 补码的加法和减法

  • 加法 ：\([X+Y]_{ ext{补}} = [X]_{ ext{补}} +[Y]_{ ext{补}}\) ( 结果仍为补码 )
  • 减法 ：\([X-Y]_{ ext{补}} = [X]_{ ext{补}} +[-Y]_{ ext{补}}\) ( 将减法转为”加负数的补码” )
  • 示例 ：5-3 \( o\)等价 5+ ( -3 ) \( o\) \([5]_{ ext{补}}=00000101 +[-3]_{ ext{补}}=11111101 = 100000010\) ( 舍去进位 ) \( o\) 结果 00000010 ( 补码) \( o\) 十进制2

1.3.3 无符号整数

  • 定义：没有符号位，所有位均为数值位，仅表示非负数.
  • 范围 ：\(n\)位无符号整数的表示范围是 \(0 \sim 2^n -1\).
    • 示例 ： \(8\) 位无符号整数 \( o\) \(0\sim 255\)

1.3.4 字符表示法

  • \(ASCII\) 码 ：\(7\) 位编码，可表示 \(128\) 个字符 ( 数字、字母、符号… ).
    • 示例 ： ‘\(0\)’ \( o\) \(48\) ( 十进制 ); ‘\(A\)’ \( o\) \(65\); ‘\(a\)’ \( o\) \(97\)
  • 汉字编码 ：如 \(GB2312\) 、 \(UTF\)-\(8\) ( \(Unicode\) 的一种实现 ) ，用于表示汉字…非\(ASCII\) 字符.

1.4 几种基本的逻辑运算

1.4.1 “与”运算 ( \(AND\) )

  • 符号 ：& 或 \(\land\)
  • 规则 ：全 \(1\) 则\(1\)，有 \(0\) 则 \(0\).
  • 示例 ：\(1011 \ \& \0101 = 0001\)

1.4.2 “或”运算 ( \(OR\) )

  • 符号 ：| 或 \(\lor\)
  • 规则 ：有 \(1\) 则\(1\)，全 \(0\) 则 \(0\).
  • 示例 ：\(1011 \ | \ 0101= 1111\)

1.4.3 “非”运算 ( \(NOT\) )

  • 符号 ：\(\sim\) 或 \( eg\)
  • 规则 ：取反 (\(1 o0\)，\(0 o 1\)).
  • 示例 ：\(\sim 1011 ext{ ( 4位 ) } = 0100\)

1.4.4 “异或”运算 ( \(XOR\) )

  • 符号 ：^ 或 \(\oplus\)
  • 规则 ：相同则 \(0\)，不同则 \(1\).
  • 示例 ：\(1011\) ^\(0101 = 1110\)

1.5 进阶要点与常见坑

  • 进制转换进阶 :
    • 非终止小数 : 十进制 \(0.1\)在二进制为无限循环, 实际计算需截断或舍入.
    • 舍入策略 : 常见为向下截断、四舍五入或银行家舍入.
    • 验算 : 将结果再转换回原进制检查误差范围.
  • 二进制算术与溢出 :
    • 无符号加法的进位检测 : 最终进位 \( o\) \(CF\).
    • 有符号加法的溢出检测 : 同号相加且结果符号改变 \( o\) \(OF\).
    • 示例 : \([0111\ 1111]_2 + [0000\ 0001]_2 =[1000\ 0000]_2\) , \(OF = 1\) ,\(CF = 0\).
  • 补码范围与符号扩展 :
    • \(n\) 位补码范围 : \(-2^{n-1} \sim 2^{n-1} - 1\).
    • 符号扩展 : 将最高位复制到新增的高位.
    • 示例 : \(8\) 位 \([1111\ 1010]_2\) 扩展到 \(16\) 位 \( o\) \([1111\1111\ 1111\ 1010]_2\).
  • 按位逻辑性质 :
    • 交换律 : \(A \land B = B \land A\), \(A \lor B = B \lor A\).
    • 结合律 : ( \(A \land B\) ) \(\land\) \(C\) = \(A\) \(\land\) ( \(B\land C\) ).
    • 分配律 : \(A \land ( B \lor C ) = ( A\land B ) \lor ( A \land C )\).
    • 德摩根律 : \( eg ( A \land B ) = ( eg A) \lor ( eg B )\) , \( eg ( A \lor B) = ( eg A ) \land ( eg B )\).
  • 常用位运算技巧 :
    • 清零某一位 : \(X \land \sim ( 1 \ll k)\).
    • 置位某一位 : \(X \lor ( 1 \ll k)\).
    • 切换某一位 : \(X \oplus ( 1 \ll k)\).
    • 判断奇偶 : \(X \land 1\) 为 \(1\) 则奇数 , 为 \(0\) 则偶数.
  • 进位与借位直观理解 :
    • 加法 : 两数在某位产生和为 \(2\) 或\(3\) 时向高位进 \(1\).
    • 减法 : 若被减位小于减数位则向高位借 \(1\) , 借来后等效增加 \(2\).

entry.title: 英语议论文写作终极指南
entry.content:
英语议论文写作终极指南

议论文的核心价值在于用逻辑征服读者，而非单纯表达观点.相较于基础框架，进阶写作更强调结构的精细化、论证的深度、语言的专业性以及对不同场景的适配性.

结构体系: 从 “标准化框架” 到“逻辑闭环”

基础结构 ( 引言-主体-反驳-结论 )是骨架，进阶写作需为每个部分注入「功能明确的细节设计」，形成“提出争议→分层论证→回应质疑→升华观点”的完整逻辑链.

引言段: 3步打造 “抓眼且立骨”的开篇

引言的核心任务是 “激活话题+明确立场”，避免冗长铺垫.高分引言需包含「钩子→背景聚焦→论点句」三重逻辑，且每层都有可操作的进阶技巧.

(1) 钩子 ( Hook ) : 从“通用开头” 到 “精准切入”

普通钩子多依赖 “Nowadays…”等空泛表达，进阶钩子需结合话题特性，用具体信息激活读者兴趣.常见进阶类型及示例:

  • 数据冲击型适用于社会、科技、教育类话题，用权威数据制造认知反差

    “The World Economic Forum reports that 85% of jobs in 2030 willrequire skills not yet mainstream in current curricula—a statistic thatforces us to rethink the purpose of higher education.”

  • 场景代入型适用于伦理、生活类话题，用具体场景引发情感共鸣

    “A teenager stays up until 2 a.m. scrolling through social media,ignoring pending homework, then wakes up exhausted for school. Thisscene repeats in millions of households, raising urgent questions aboutscreen time regulations for minors.”

  • 权威引用型适用于学术、政策类话题，借权威观点确立话题重要性

    “As Nobel laureate Amartya Sen argued, ‘Education is the mostpowerful tool for changing the world’—yet global data shows 258 millionchildren lack access to basic schooling. The gap between ideal andreality demands a re-examination of educational funding priorities.”

(2) 背景聚焦 ( Context ) : 避免“泛泛而谈”

背景介绍需完成「从宏观到具体」的收缩，明确话题的争议焦点. 错误示范: “Online education is popular now.People have different opinions.” 进阶示范:

“Since the COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the adoption of onlinelearning, schools worldwide have faced a critical choice: maintainremote education as a permanent option or return to fully in-personclasses. The debate centers on whether online learning can match theacademic rigor and social development benefits of traditionalclassrooms.”

(3) 论点句 ( ThesisStatement ) : 从 “表态” 到 “亮逻辑”

论点句不仅要明确立场，更要预告全文的 论证框架 ( 即“essay map” ) ，让读者清晰把握你的推理路径.

  • 基础版: “Online learning is better than traditional classes.”
  • 进阶版: “Online learning offers superior educational value byproviding flexible scheduling, personalized learning paths, and broaderaccess to resources—addressing the key limitations of traditionalclassroom education.”

主体段: PEEL结构的 “深度升级”

基础PEEL ( 观点-证据-解释-衔接 )需强化「证据的权威性」和「解释的逻辑性」，避免”观点+例子”的浅层论证.进阶主体段需满足:每个分论点独立成段，论证链完整且细节充足.

(1) 观点句 ( Point ) :精准对接论点句

观点句需是论点句的「具体化拆解」，且包含「核心立场+论证角度」.

  • 论点句: “Universities should require PE courses for allstudents.”
  • 观点句1 ( 健康角度 ) : “Mandatory PE courses directly improvestudents’ mental health, which is closely linked to academicperformance.”
  • 观点句2 ( 习惯角度 ) : “College is a critical period for habitformation, and structured PE programs help instill long-term healthylifestyle choices.”

(2) 证据 ( Evidence ) :从 “单一举例” 到 “多元佐证”

证据质量决定论证力度，进阶写作需结合2-3种证据类型，并标注来源增强可信度.常见证据组合策略:

论证场景证据组合示例
社会现象分析权威数据 + 案例研究
( WEF数据 + 某公司实践案例 )
教育政策论证学术研究 + 专家观点
( 哈佛教育学院研究 + 教育部长发言 )
伦理问题探讨具体案例 + 统计数据
( 某地区事件 + 全国范围内的调查数据 )

证据呈现技巧避免直接堆砌，需说明证据来源和核心信息.

  • 错误: “PE helps with grades. A study said so.”
  • 正确: “A 2024 longitudinal study published in the Journal ofCollege Student Development tracked 5,000 undergraduates and foundthat those who took mandatory PE courses scored 12% higher on finalexams, citing reduced stress and improved focus as key factors.”

(3) 解释 (Explanation ) : 完成 “证据→观点” 的逻辑搭桥

解释是主体段的「灵魂」，需回答两个问题: ① 证据说明了什么? ②这如何支持我的观点? 常用解释角度:

  • 因果分析: “The study’s findings confirm that physical activitytriggers the release of endorphins, which reduce anxiety—allowingstudents to concentrate better during lectures and retain informationmore effectively.”
  • 对比分析: “In contrast, students who skipped PE reported 37% higherstress levels and more frequent missed classes, showing that withoutstructured physical activity, academic performance suffers.”
  • 意义延伸: “This connection between PE and academic success meansmandatory courses are not just ‘extra’—they are an investment instudents’ overall educational outcomes.”

(4) 衔接 ( Link ) : 强化“段落→论点” 的关联

衔接句需明确将本段内容与核心论点挂钩，避免逻辑断裂.

“By improving mental health and academic performance, mandatory PEcourses directly fulfill universities’ mission of fostering holisticstudent development—supporting the case for making them arequirement.”

反驳段: 从 “简单否定” 到“辩证回应”

反驳的核心是“先承认合理性，再指出局限性”，体现批判性思维.进阶反驳需遵循「让步→转折→佐证→衔接」四步结构.

经典结构示例:

“Admittedly, critics of mandatory PE courses raise a valid concernabout student autonomy. They argue that university students are adultswho should be free to choose how to allocate their time, and thatmandatory PE may conflict with tight schedules for majors like pre-medor engineering . However, this argument overlooks two key points: first,most universities design PE courses to be flexible, offering evening andweekend sections that accommodate busy schedules; second, the benefitsof physical activity—such as improved focus and reduced burnout—areparticularly valuable for high-stress majors. A 2023 survey of pre-medstudents at Stanford found that those who took PE courses reported 28%lower rates of academic burnout than their peers who did not. Thus,mandatory PE does not undermine autonomy but rather supports students’ability to succeed in their chosen paths.”

结论段: 从 “重复观点” 到“升华价值”

结论需完成「总结→重申→升华」三步，避免引入新观点，同时提升论证格局.

进阶结构示例:

“In summary, mandatory PE courses deliver tangible benefits: theyimprove students’ mental health and academic performance, instilllifelong healthy habits, and accommodate busy schedules through flexibleofferings. While concerns about student autonomy are understandable, theevidence shows these courses support rather than hinder students’ goals. Ultimately, universities exist not only to teach academic skills butto prepare students for healthy, productive lives. Mandatory PE is asmall but powerful step toward fulfilling that mission—one that benefitsboth individuals and society as a whole.”

论证方法: 从 “单一说理” 到“多维说服”

进阶写作需灵活组合多种论证方法，根据话题特性选择最具说服力的策略.以下为4种核心论证方法的「适用场景+进阶技巧」.

举例论证: 从 “模糊案例” 到“具体场景”

普通举例多为 “For example, somestudents…”，进阶举例需包含「具体主体+行为+结果」，让读者产生代入感.

  • 基础版: “Social media harms teenagers’ mental health. For example,some teens feel anxious.”
  • 进阶版: “Social media use correlates with increased anxiety inteenagers. A 15-year-old in Chicago, for instance, told researchers shechecks Instagram 50+ times a day and feels ‘worthless’ when her postsget fewer likes than peers—symptoms that align with the study’s findingthat excessive social media use raises teen anxiety rates by 25% .”

因果论证: 从 “简单归因” 到“逻辑链延伸”

因果论证需避免 “post hoc ergo propter hoc” ( 事后归因 )谬误，需明确「中间环节」.进阶因果论证可采用「多因一果」或「一因多果」结构.

多因一果示例 ( 分析“青少年肥胖率上升” ) :

“Teen obesity rates have risen 40% in the past decade due to threeinterconnected factors. First, processed food consumption has increased:fast food chains now have 2.3x more locations near high schools than in2010, making unhealthy options easily accessible. Second, physicalactivity has declined: the average teen spends 7+ hours daily onscreens, leaving little time for sports or outdoor play. Third, parentalhabits play a role: 68% of obese teens have parents who consumehigh-sugar diets, as family eating patterns strongly influencechildren’s choices. Together, these factors create an environment thatpromotes weight gain.”

对比论证: 从 “表面比较” 到“本质分析”

对比论证需围绕「核心维度」展开，避免无意义的罗列. 常用两种结构:

  • 整体对比 先全面论述A，再论述B ( 适用于复杂话题)

    “Traditional classrooms excel at in-person interaction: teachers canimmediately notice when a student is confused and adjust theirexplanation, and group activities build teamwork skills. Onlineclassrooms, by contrast, prioritize flexibility: students in rural areascan access courses from top universities, and working teens can studyafter their shifts. The key difference lies in their goals: traditionallearning focuses on immediate engagement, while online learning focuseson accessibility.”

  • 细节对比 围绕同一维度对比A和B (适用于观点对立类话题 )

    维度传统课堂在线课堂
    互动及时性教师可实时回应学生疑问依赖留言/邮件，存在延迟
    学习灵活性固定时间地点，难以调整可自主安排时间，适配多样需求
    资源可及性受限于学校师资和藏书可接入全球优质课程和数据库

引用论证: 从 “随意引用” 到“精准适配”

引用需满足「权威来源+精准解读」，避免为引用而引用. 进阶引用技巧:

  • 优先选择 同行评审期刊、政府报告、权威机构数据 (如WHO、Pew Research Center ) ，避免博客、非权威网站.

  • 引用后需「解释引用内容的意义」，而非直接结束论证.

    “As Dr. Andrew Ng, a leading AI expert, noted, ‘AI will create moreopportunities than it will destroy’ . This aligns with the WorldEconomic Forum’s projection that AI will create 96.9 million new jobs by2025—jobs in AI development, data analysis, and human-AI collaborationthat did not exist a decade ago. Ng’s expertise in AI research and theWEF’s data on labor markets together strengthen the case that AI’sjob-creation potential outweighs its displacement risks.”

语言风格: 从 “正确表达” 到“专业精准”

语言是议论文的”外衣”，进阶写作需在「词汇、句式、语气」上体现学术性和说服力.

词汇升级: 从 “基础词汇” 到“精准表达”

避免口语化、模糊化词汇，使用更具学术性的表达. 以下为高频替换表:

基础词汇进阶替换词/短语适用场景
thinkargue, contend, maintain, assert表达观点
good/badbeneficial, valuable / detrimental, adverse评价事物影响
veryconsiderably, significantly, remarkably强调程度
helpfacilitate, contribute to, enhance说明积极作用
hurtundermine, impair, compromise说明消极影响
showdemonstrate, reveal, indicate引出证据或结论

句式变化: 从 “简单句堆砌” 到“长短结合”

进阶写作需灵活运用「复合句、倒装句、强调句」，增强语言节奏感.

句式升级示例:

  • 简单句: “Online learning is flexible. Students like it. It helpsthem balance work and study.”
  • 进阶句: “Online learning’s flexibility— which allows students tobalance work and study— makes it highly popular among adult learners .Not only does it eliminate geographic barriers, but it also enablespersonalized learning paces that traditional classrooms cannotmatch.”

实用句式模板:

  • 强调观点: “What makes mandatory PE essential is its role infostering holistic development, not just physical health.”
  • 引出证据: “Research by the National Center for Education Statisticsprovides compelling support for this claim:…”
  • 转折对比: “While it is true that online learning lacks face-to-faceinteraction, modern virtual tools have largely addressed this gap.”

语气规范: 从 “主观随意” 到“客观严谨”

议论文需保持 正式、客观 的语气，避免以下误区:

  • 避免口语化表达: 不用”kind of”“sort of”“you know”等.
  • 避免绝对化表述: 用”tendto”“often”“may”替代”always”“must”“never”.
    > 错误: “Online learning always works better.”
    > 正确: “Online learning often works better for students withflexible schedules.”
  • 避免第一/二人称: 学术议论文中 ( 如大学论文 )通常不用”I”“you”，可用”the author argues”“one can conclude”; 标准化考试( 如雅思 ) 可适当用”I believe”，但需减少频率.

考试专项

话题倾向与模板:

高频话题: 教育、科技、社会、环境. 推荐使用「平衡论证结构」:

引言: 背景+双方争议+个人立场
主体段1: 支持方观点+证据
主体段2: 反对方观点+反驳+证据
结论: 重申立场+总结理由+升华

大学英语四六级 (30分钟，120-180词 )

题型特点

多为 “观点对比” “利弊分析” “问题解决”类话题，对语言准确性要求高于深度.

万能模板 ( 观点对比型 ):

引言: “In recent years, the debate over whether…has sparked heateddiscussion. Some argue that…, while others believe that…. From myperspective,…”
主体段1: “Firstly,… For example,… This shows that…”
主体段2: “Secondly,… A case in point is that… Thus,…”
反驳段: “Admittedly,… However,…”
结论: “To conclude,… This choice not only… but also…”

实战纠错: 从 “常见误区” 到“高分突破”

结构类错误及修正

错误类型错误示例修正示例
论点句模糊“Social media is bad for teenagers.”“Social media harms teenagers’ mental health by increasing anxietyand reducing face-to-face interaction.”
主体段多观点混杂一段内同时讲”手机分心”“手机作弊”“手机有益”拆分三段，每段聚焦一个观点:段1讲分心，段2讲作弊，段3反驳”手机有益”的观点
反驳段缺乏佐证“Critics are wrong because online learning is flexible.”“Critics’ concern about online learning’s lack of interaction isoutdated: virtual discussion forums and video conferences allowreal-time engagement, as shown by Stanford’s 2023 study .”

逻辑类错误及修正

  • 稻草人谬误 歪曲对方观点再攻击
    错误: “Opponents want to ban all technology in schools, which isabsurd.”
    修正: “Opponents argue that technology should be regulated in classroomsto reduce distraction, but this does not mean banning itentirely—rather, setting clear rules for use.”
  • 滑坡谬误 假设小变化导致极端后果
    错误: “If we allow phones in class, students will stop learningentirely.”
    修正: “If phones are used without regulation in class, students may bedistracted by social media, leading to lower participation and retentionrates.”
  • 以偏概全 用个别案例代表整体
    错误: “My friend failed math because of online learning, so it’sineffective.”
    修正: “While some students struggle with online learning due to lack ofself-discipline, 78% of learners report improved satisfaction withflexible schedules .”

语言类错误及修正

错误类型错误示例修正示例
词汇搭配不当“Online learning improves students’ study efficiency verymuch.”“Online learning significantly enhances students’ studyefficiency.”
句式单一“PE is good for health. PE helps with grades. PE should bemandatory.”“PE benefits both physical health and academic performance, makingit a worthwhile mandatory requirement .”
冠词/时态错误“I think technology play important role in education.”“I believe technology plays an important role in education.”

高分实战资源包

话题词汇库 ( 按高频主题分类 )

  • 教育类 curriculum design ( 课程设计 ) 、pedagogicalapproach ( 教学方法 ) 、academic rigor ( 学术严谨性 ) 、holisticdevelopment ( 全面发展 )
  • 科技类 artificial intelligence ( 人工智能 )、digital literacy ( 数字素养 ) 、technological disruption ( 技术颠覆 )、data privacy ( 数据隐私 )
  • 社会类 demographic change ( 人口结构变化 ) 、socialmobility ( 社会流动性 ) 、cultural integration ( 文化融合 ) 、publicwelfare ( 公共福利 )

修订自查清单 ( 基于ENG 112标准)

✅ 引言是否有清晰的钩子和背景介绍?
✅ 论点句是否明确且包含论证框架?
✅ 每个主体段是否有观点、证据、解释和衔接?
✅ 反驳段是否承认对方合理性并提供佐证?
✅ 结论是否重申观点且未引入新内容?
✅ 引用是否标注来源且与论点相关?
✅ 语言是否正式，无口语化和绝对化表达?
✅ 语法、拼写、标点是否准确?

经典范文及批注 ( 教育类话题 )

题目: Should schools teach financial literacy tochildren?

引言 “A 15-year-old spends their entire allowance onvideo games, then cannot afford textbooks—this scenario is increasinglycommon due to lack of financial education . While some argue thatschools should focus solely on academic subjects, this essay contendsthat financial literacy is a core life skill that deserves a place inthe curriculum. Teaching budgeting, saving, and responsible spendingprepares children for adult independence and reduces future financialhardship.”
( 批注: 用场景钩子引入，明确争议焦点，论点句包含”是什么+为什么” )

主体段1 “First, financial literacy addresses acritical gap in young people’s knowledge. A 2024 survey by the NationalEndowment for Financial Education found that 89% of 18-24-year-oldsstruggle to create a budget, and 62% have credit card debt. This showsthat without formal teaching, children do not naturally developfinancial skills. Schools, as primary educational institutions, are bestpositioned to fill this gap—by integrating lessons on budgeting intomath classes or personal development courses.”
( 批注: 数据+解释+衔接，逻辑链完整 )

反驳段 “Critics argue that adding financial literacywill overcrowd already packed curricula. While it is true that schoolsface time constraints, financial literacy can be integrated intoexisting subjects rather than taught as a separate course. For example,math classes can use budgeting exercises to teach percentages, andsocial studies can explore how personal finance relates to the economy.This way, schools do not sacrifice academic content but rather enhanceit with practical skills.”
( 批注: 先让步再提出解决方案，可行性强 )

结论 “In conclusion, financial literacy is not an‘extra’ but an essential part of education. It equips children withskills to avoid debt, manage resources, and build securefutures—outcomes that align with schools’ mission of preparing studentsfor life. By integrating financial lessons into existing curricula,schools can ensure that every child leaves with the tools to thrivefinancially.”
( 批注: 升华到教育使命，格局清晰 )

终极建议 议论文的进阶本质是「逻辑+细节+练习」的结合.每周选择1个高频话题，按照 “审题→列提纲→写作→对照清单修改”的流程训练，3-4周即可明显提升论证深度和语言专业性. 记住: 高分议论文不是“写得漂亮”，而是 “说得服人”.

entry.title: 固定搭配-5
entry.content:
说明

  • 💫 释义 ( Meaning )
  • 🫧 例句 ( Example )
  • 🌈 同义 ( Synonym )

本文章较长，可通过 目录 或 ctrl +F 搜索.

Part 41

grow by

  • 💫 释义 增长了 ( 具体数值或百分比 )
    • 🫧 例句 The company’s revenue grewby 15% last quarter.
    • 🌈 同义 increase by, rise by
  • 💫 释义 增加了 ( 具体数量 )
    • 🫧 例句 Our user base grew by50,000 this month.
    • 🌈 同义 expand by, enlarge by
  • 💫 释义 以…的幅度增长
    • 🫧 例句 The population grew by2 million people in five years.
    • 🌈 同义 be up by, show growth of

as opposed to

  • 💫 释义 而不是, 与…相对
    • 🫧 例句 We need quality as opposedto quantity.
    • 🌈 同义 rather than, in contrast to
  • 💫 释义 与…相反
    • 🫧 例句 She prefers tea as opposedto coffee.
    • 🌈 同义 instead of, unlike
  • 💫 释义 相较于
    • 🫧 例句 The course focuses on practical skillsas opposed to theoretical knowledge.
    • 🌈 同义 in comparison with, as distinguishedfrom

a…approach to

  • 💫 释义 一种…的方法/途径
    • 🫧 例句 We need a systematic approachto solving this problem.
    • 🌈 同义 a method for, a way of dealingwith
  • 💫 释义 …的处理方式
    • 🫧 例句 The company adopted a flexibleapproach to remote work.
    • 🌈 同义 a manner of handling, a strategyfor
  • 💫 释义 对待…的态度
    • 🫧 例句 She has a positive approachto challenges.
    • 🌈 同义 an attitude toward, a perspectiveon

help divert…from

  • 💫 释义 有助于使…从…转移开
    • 🫧 例句 The new program helpsdivert young people from criminalactivities.
    • 🌈 同义 assist in redirecting…from, aid inturning…away from
  • 💫 释义 帮助…远离
    • 🫧 例句 These measures helpdivert traffic from the city center.
    • 🌈 同义 contribute to shifting…from, supportmoving…away from
  • 💫 释义 协助…从…分流
    • 🫧 例句 The campaign helpsdivert waste from landfills.
    • 🌈 同义 facilitate the redirection of…from,enable the diversion of…from

in the first place

  • 💫 释义 起初, 一开始
    • 🫧 例句 Why did you choose this methodin the first place ?
    • 🌈 同义 originally, initially
  • 💫 释义 首先 ( 用于列举理由 )
    • 🫧 例句 I don’t want to go because, inthe first place, I’m too tired.
    • 🌈 同义 firstly, to begin with
  • 💫 释义 根本 ( 强调原本情况 )
    • 🫧 例句 You shouldn’t have been therein the first place.
    • 🌈 同义 from the start, at the outset

make it easier for sb. todo

  • 💫 释义 使某人更容易做某事
    • 🫧 例句 The new software makes iteasier for employees to track theirwork.
    • 🌈 同义 facilitate sb. doing, enable sb. to domore easily
  • 💫 释义 为某人提供便利以…
    • 🫧 例句 Online banking makes it easierfor customers to manage theiraccounts.
    • 🌈 同义 simplify the process for sb. to do,reduce difficulties for sb. to do
  • 💫 释义 降低某人做某事的难度
    • 🫧 例句 This tool makes it easierfor beginners to learn programming.
    • 🌈 同义 lower barriers for sb. to do, help sb.do sth. more easily

have a role to play

  • 💫 释义 可以发挥作用, 有参与的价值
    • 🫧 例句 Teachers have an important roleto play in students’ development.
    • 🌈 同义 can contribute, have a part toplay
  • 💫 释义 能够起到作用
    • 🫧 例句 Technology has a key role toplay in modern education.
    • 🌈 同义 can make a difference, can have animpact
  • 💫 释义 有责任参与
    • 🫧 例句 Everyone has a role toplay in protecting the environment.
    • 🌈 同义 have responsibility to participate, beinvolved in

in the eyes of

  • 💫 释义 在…看来, 在…眼中
    • 🫧 例句 In the eyes of thelaw, everyone is equal.
    • 🌈 同义 from the perspective of, as seenby
  • 💫 释义 按…的观点
    • 🫧 例句 The decision was correct in theeyes of most experts.
    • 🌈 同义 according to, in the opinionof
  • 💫 释义 在…心目中
    • 🫧 例句 He remains a hero in the eyesof his supporters.
    • 🌈 同义 in the view of, as perceivedby

at the heart of

  • 💫 释义 处于…的核心, 是…的关键
    • 🫧 例句 Trust is at the heartof any successful relationship.
    • 🌈 同义 central to, core to
  • 💫 释义 在…的中心位置
    • 🫧 例句 The new park is at the heartof the community.
    • 🌈 同义 in the center of, positioned centrallyin
  • 💫 释义 作为…的实质内容
    • 🫧 例句 This issue is at the heartof our discussion today.
    • 🌈 同义 fundamental to, essential to

trick sb. into doingsth.

  • 💫 释义 骗某人做某事
    • 🫧 例句 He tricked me intosigning the contract.
    • 🌈 同义 deceive sb. into doing sth.
  • 💫 释义 诱使某人做某事
    • 🫧 例句 The email tried to trick usersinto revealing passwords.
    • 🌈 同义 lure sb. into doing sth.
  • 💫 释义 哄骗某人做某事
    • 🫧 例句 She tricked the childinto eating vegetables.
    • 🌈 同义 fool sb. into doing sth.

Part 42

on high alert about

  • 💫 释义 对…保持高度警惕
    • 🫧 例句 Security forces are on highalert about potential threats.
    • 🌈 同义 highly vigilant about, very watchfulregarding
  • 💫 释义 密切关注…
    • 🫧 例句 Hospitals are on high alertabout the spread of the virus.
    • 🌈 同义 closely monitoring, paying closeattention to
  • 💫 释义 对…严加防范
    • 🫧 例句 Investors are on high alertabout market fluctuations.
    • 🌈 同义 extremely cautious about, very waryof

keep sb. away from

  • 💫 释义 使某人远离…
    • 🫧 例句 Parents should keep childrenaway from dangerous objects.
    • 🌈 同义 prevent sb. from approaching, stop sb.from going near
  • 💫 释义 不让某人接触…
    • 🫧 例句 The doctor advised keeping himaway from alcohol.
    • 🌈 同义 ensure sb. avoids, make sure sb. staysclear of
  • 💫 释义 使某人与…保持距离
    • 🫧 例句 She tried to keep her son awayfrom bad influences.
    • 🌈 同义 distance sb. from, separate sb.from

time limit on

  • 💫 释义 对…的时间限制
    • 🫧 例句 There’s a 30-minute time limiton the exam.
    • 🌈 同义 time constraint on, deadlinefor
  • 💫 释义 …的时限
    • 🫧 例句 The company set a strict timelimit on the project.
    • 🌈 同义 time restriction on, cutoff timefor
  • 💫 释义 规定…的时间
    • 🫧 例句 There should be a time limiton how long people can park here.
    • 🌈 同义 prescribed time for, allotted timefor

compare tricks for

  • 💫 释义 比较…的技巧/方法
    • 🫧 例句 Let’s compare tricksfor improving memory.
    • 🌈 同义 evaluate methods for, assess techniquesfor
  • 💫 释义 对比…的窍门
    • 🫧 例句 The article compares tricksfor saving money on groceries.
    • 🌈 同义 examine strategies for, review tipsfor
  • 💫 释义 评比…的妙招
    • 🫧 例句 We should compare tricksfor learning languages faster.
    • 🌈 同义 contrast approaches for, analyze hacksfor

stay out of

  • 💫 释义 不参与, 避开
    • 🫧 例句 You should stay out oftheir personal arguments.
    • 🌈 同义 avoid involvement in, keep awayfrom
  • 💫 释义 不介入, 远离
    • 🫧 例句 I prefer to stay outof office politics.
    • 🌈 同义 remain uninvolved in, steer clearof
  • 💫 释义 不插手
    • 🫧 例句 The government warned other countriesto stay out of their internal affairs.
    • 🌈 同义 not interfere with, not meddlein

as it turned out

  • 💫 释义 结果表明, 最终发现
    • 🫧 例句 As it turned out, hehad already left the company.
    • 🌈 同义 in the end, as thingsdeveloped
  • 💫 释义 事实证明
    • 🫧 例句 As it turned out, thesolution was much simpler than we thought.
    • 🌈 同义 as events proved, as becameapparent
  • 💫 释义 实际情况是
    • 🫧 例句 I thought I was late, but as itturned out, the meeting was postponed.
    • 🌈 同义 in reality, actually

proposal to deal with

  • 💫 释义 处理…的提案
    • 🫧 例句 The government presented a newproposal to deal with climate change.
    • 🌈 同义 plan to address, scheme tohandle
  • 💫 释义 应对…的方案
    • 🫧 例句 We need a concrete proposal todeal with the budget deficit.
    • 🌈 同义 solution for managing, approach totackling
  • 💫 释义 解决…的建议
    • 🫧 例句 The committee discussed severalproposals to deal with traffic congestion.
    • 🌈 同义 recommendation for handling, strategyfor coping with

end up being

  • 💫 释义 最终成为, 结果是
    • 🫧 例句 The small project ended upbeing a huge success.
    • 🌈 同义 turn out to be, eventuallybecome
  • 💫 释义 到头来是
    • 🫧 例句 What I thought was a simple taskended up being very complicated.
    • 🌈 同义 prove to be, wind up being
  • 💫 释义 最后变成
    • 🫧 例句 Their argument ended upbeing resolved peacefully.
    • 🌈 同义 ultimately become, finally be

curb on

  • 💫 释义 对…的限制, 抑制
    • 🫧 例句 The government imposed a curbon public spending.
    • 🌈 同义 restriction on, limit on
  • 💫 释义 控制…的措施
    • 🫧 例句 There should be stricter curbson pollution.
    • 🌈 同义 control on, check on
  • 💫 释义 约束…的规定
    • 🫧 例句 The new law places a curbon excessive noise.
    • 🌈 同义 restraint on, regulation of

the price to pay for

  • 💫 释义 为…付出的代价
    • 🫧 例句 Long working hours are theprice to pay for career success.
    • 🌈 同义 the cost of, the sacrificefor
  • 💫 释义 获得…必须承受的后果
    • 🫧 例句 Environmental damage is theprice to pay for industrial development.
    • 🌈 同义 the consequence of, the penaltyfor
  • 💫 释义 为…不得不接受的代价
    • 🫧 例句 Stress is often the price topay for high achievement.
    • 🌈 同义 the trade-off for, the downsideof

Part 43

fall on

  • 💫 释义 落在…身上 ( 责任、义务等 )
    • 🫧 例句 The responsibility will fallon the team leader.
    • 🌈 同义 be borne by, rest with
  • 💫 释义 适逢 ( 某日期 )
    • 🫧 例句 This year, Christmas fallson a Sunday.
    • 🌈 同义 occur on, happen to be on
  • 💫 释义 袭击, 扑向
    • 🫧 例句 The soldiers fell onthe enemy camp at dawn.
    • 🌈 同义 attack, assault
  • 💫 释义 目光落在, 注意到
    • 🫧 例句 His eyes fell on anold photograph.
    • 🌈 同义 notice, spot

fall on deaf ears

  • 💫 释义 未被听取, 不被理会
    • 🫧 例句 Our complaints fell on deafears.
    • 🌈 同义 be ignored, go unheeded

be famous for

  • 💫 释义 以…而闻名
    • 🫧 例句 Italy is famous forits delicious cuisine.
    • 🌈 同义 be renowned for, be known for
  • 💫 释义 因…而出名
    • 🫧 例句 The city is famous forits historical landmarks.
    • 🌈 同义 be celebrated for, be notedfor
  • 💫 释义 以…著称
    • 🫧 例句 She is famous for herphilanthropic work.
    • 🌈 同义 be recognized for, be distinguishedfor

come round to

  • 💫 释义 改变主意同意, 最终接受
    • 🫧 例句 He eventually came roundto my way of thinking.
    • 🌈 同义 be persuaded to accept, eventuallyagree with
  • 💫 释义 转而支持, 认同
    • 🫧 例句 After discussing it, she cameround to the idea.
    • 🌈 同义 change one’s mind about, warm upto
  • 💫 释义 回心转意, 被说服
    • 🫧 例句 It took some time, but they finallycame round to our proposal.
    • 🌈 同义 become convinced of, yield to

pick up on

  • 💫 释义 注意到, 察觉到
    • 🫧 例句 She quickly picked upon his nervousness.
    • 🌈 同义 notice, detect
  • 💫 释义 领会, 理解
    • 🫧 例句 The students picked upon the main points of the lecture.
    • 🌈 同义 grasp, understand
  • 💫 释义 接收并回应
    • 🫧 例句 The media picked up onthe story and it went viral.
    • 🌈 同义 take up, respond to
  • 💫 释义 接续 ( 话题等 )
    • 🫧 例句 Let me pick up on whatyou said earlier about the budget.
    • 🌈 同义 follow up on, continue with

integrate into

  • 💫 释义 融入, 整合进
    • 🫧 例句 New employees need time tointegrate into the team.
    • 🌈 同义 become part of, merge into
  • 💫 释义 纳入, 使成为一部分
    • 🫧 例句 The software will be integratedinto our existing system.
    • 🌈 同义 incorporate into, blend into
  • 💫 释义 结合到…中
    • 🫧 例句 Sustainable practices should beintegrated into business operations.
    • 🌈 同义 fit into, be absorbed into

address limitations

  • 💫 释义 处理/解决局限性
    • 🫧 例句 The new version addresseslimitations of the previous model.
    • 🌈 同义 deal with constraints, tackleshortcomings
  • 💫 释义 应对不足之处
    • 🫧 例句 We need to address thelimitations in our current approach.
    • 🌈 同义 overcome weaknesses, handlerestrictions
  • 💫 释义 改进缺陷
    • 🫧 例句 The update addresses severallimitations reported by users.
    • 🌈 同义 fix deficiencies, improvedrawbacks

plague with

  • 💫 释义 用…困扰, 使备受…折磨
    • 🫧 例句 The system has been plaguedwith technical problems.
    • 🌈 同义 trouble with, burden with
  • 💫 释义 不断遭受…的困扰
    • 🫧 例句 The project was plaguedwith delays and budget overruns.
    • 🌈 同义 beset with, be afflicted with
  • 💫 释义 被…所累
    • 🫧 例句 The region has been plaguedwith political instability.
    • 🌈 同义 suffer from, be troubled by
  • 💫 释义 充斥 ( 负面事物 )
    • 🫧 例句 Social media is plaguedwith misinformation.
    • 🌈 同义 be filled with ( negatively ), beoverwhelmed by

push boundaries

  • 💫 释义 突破界限, 挑战极限
    • 🫧 例句 This research pushesboundaries in medical science.
    • 🌈 同义 break new ground, expandlimits
  • 💫 释义 超越常规
    • 🫧 例句 The artist is known for pushingboundaries in contemporary art.
    • 🌈 同义 go beyond conventions, challengenorms
  • 💫 释义 开拓新领域
    • 🫧 例句 The company continues to pushboundaries of innovation.
    • 🌈 同义 extend frontiers, advance beyondexisting limits

in the realm of

  • 💫 释义 在…领域内, 在…范畴中
    • 🫧 例句 This is a significant discoveryin the realm of quantum physics.
    • 🌈 同义 in the field of, within the domainof
  • 💫 释义 属于…的范围
    • 🫧 例句 These questions fall in therealm of philosophy.
    • 🌈 同义 in the sphere of, in the areaof
  • 💫 释义 在…的王国里 ( 比喻 )
    • 🫧 例句 In the realm offantasy, anything is possible.
    • 🌈 同义 in the world of, in the universeof

Part 44

leverage for

  • 💫 释义 利用…作为手段/杠杆
    • 🫧 例句 Education is a powerfulleverage for social change.
    • 🌈 同义 tool for, instrument for
  • 💫 释义 用作…的杠杆作用
    • 🫧 例句 Technology can be used asleverage for improving efficiency.
    • 🌈 同义 means for, mechanism for
  • 💫 释义 作为…的支点/优势
    • 🫧 例句 Their market position gives themleverage for negotiations.
    • 🌈 同义 advantage for, bargaining powerfor

entry.title: 固定搭配-4
entry.content:
说明

  • 💫 释义 ( Meaning )
  • 🫧 例句 ( Example )
  • 🌈 同义 ( Synonym )

本文章较长，可通过 目录 或 ctrl +F 搜索.

Part 31

take responsibility

  • 💫 释义 承担责任
    • 🫧 例句 A good leader takesresponsibility for both successes and failures.
    • 🌈 同义 accept blame, be accountable

take advantage of

  • 💫 释义 利用
    • 🫧 例句 You should take advantageof this opportunity to learn.
    • 🌈 同义 make use of, capitalize on

take…for granted

  • 💫 释义 认为…理所当然
    • 🫧 例句 We often take our health forgranted until we lose it.
    • 🌈 同义 assume something will always beavailable

take…into account

  • 💫 释义 把…考虑在内
    • 🫧 例句 When making the decision, we need totake all factors into account.
    • 🌈 同义 consider, make allowance for

step down

  • 💫 释义 辞职; 让位
    • 🫧 例句 The CEO decided to stepdown after decades of service.
    • 🌈 同义 resign, relinquish one’sposition

give away

  • 💫 释义 赠送; 泄露
    • 🫧 例句 He decided to giveaway all his old books to the library.
    • 🌈 同义 donate, reveal

give back

  • 💫 释义 归还; 回报
    • 🫧 例句 Please give back themoney you borrowed last week.
    • 🌈 同义 return, repay

give in

  • 💫 释义 屈服; 让步
    • 🫧 例句 After a long negotiation, they finallygave in to our demands.
    • 🌈 同义 surrender, yield

give off

  • 💫 释义 发出, 散发出 ( 光、热、气味等 )
    • 🫧 例句 The flowers give off asweet fragrance.
    • 🌈 同义 emit, release

give out

  • 💫 释义 分发; 耗尽; 停止运转
    • 🫧 例句 The teacher gave outthe exam papers to the students.
    • 🌈 同义 distribute, run out

Part 32

give up

  • 💫 释义 放弃; 戒除
    • 🫧 例句 Never give up on yourdreams, no matter how hard it gets.
    • 🌈 同义 quit, abandon

as far back as

  • 💫 释义 早在…; 远在… ( 就 )
    • 🫧 例句 This tradition can be traced asfar back as the 18th century.
    • 🌈 同义 since, going back to

in at least

  • 💫 释义 至少在… ( 范围内 )
    • 🫧 例句 This is the highest temperaturein at least five years.
    • 🌈 同义 within a minimum of, no lessthan

in the past [number] [timeunit]

  • 💫 释义 在过去的… ( 时间 ) 里
    • 🫧 例句 The company has launched three newproducts in the past six months.
    • 🌈 同义 during the last, over thepreceding

over the last [number] [timeunit]

  • 💫 释义 在过去的… ( 时间 ) 里
    • 🫧 例句 Sales have increased by 20%over the last quarter.
    • 🌈 同义 during the past, in therecent

within a [time unit] span

  • 💫 释义 在…的时间跨度内
    • 🫧 例句 She was promoted twice within aone-year span.
    • 🌈 同义 during a period of, in a windowof

year-over-year ( YOY )

  • 💫 释义 同比的 ( 与去年同期相比 )
    • 🫧 例句 The company reported a 10%year-over-year growth in revenue.
    • 🌈 同义 compared to the same period lastyear

quarter-over-quarter ( QOQ)

  • 💫 释义 环比的 ( 与上一季度相比 )
    • 🫧 例句 Profits fell 2%quarter-over-quarter.
    • 🌈 同义 compared to the previousquarter

bear the brunt of

  • 💫 释义 承受…的主要冲击
    • 🫧 例句 Small businesses are bearingthe brunt of the economic downturn.
    • 🌈 同义 suffer the worst part of

take a hit

  • 💫 释义 遭受打击, 蒙受损失
    • 🫧 例句 Our investments took ahit during the market crash.
    • 🌈 同义 suffer a loss, be negativelyaffected

Part 33

hedge against ( inflation/risk)

  • 💫 释义 对冲 ( 通胀/风险 )
    • 🫧 例句 Many investors buy gold tohedge against inflation.
    • 🌈 同义 protect oneself from

tide over

  • 💫 释义 帮助渡过 ( 难关 )
    • 🫧 例句 The loan was enough totide the company over the cash flowcrisis.
    • 🌈 同义 help through a difficultperiod

tighten one’s belt

  • 💫 释义 勒紧裤腰带, 省吃俭用
    • 🫧 例句 After the job loss, the family had totighten their belts.
    • 🌈 同义 spend less, economize

risk appetite

  • 💫 释义 风险偏好
    • 🫧 例句 Younger investors often have a higherrisk appetite.
    • 🌈 同义 tolerance for risk

blue-chip stocks

  • 💫 释义 蓝筹股 ( 信誉良好、经营稳健的公司股票 )
    • 🫧 例句 His portfolio is mainly composed ofblue-chip stocks.
    • 🌈 同义 high-quality stocks, reliableperformers

bottom out

  • 💫 释义 触底, 降至最低点后趋于稳定
    • 🫧 例句 The housing market is finally showingsigns of bottoming out.
    • 🌈 同义 reach the lowest point

is up from

  • 💫 释义 相较于…有所上升/增加
    • 🫧 例句 The new offer is upfrom the initial proposal.
    • 🌈 同义 has increased from, is higherthan

is down from

  • 💫 释义 相较于…有所下降/减少
    • 🫧 例句 This quarter’s revenue is downfrom the same period last year.
    • 🌈 同义 has decreased from, is lowerthan

shows an increase over

  • 💫 释义 与…相比显示出增长
    • 🫧 例句 The data shows a sharp increaseover the previous month.
    • 🌈 同义 demonstrates growth comparedto

represents a jump from

  • 💫 释义 表示从…跃升
    • 🫧 例句 The latest figure represents asignificant jump from earlier estimates.
    • 🌈 同义 constitutes a rise from

Part 34

has climbed since

  • 💫 释义 自…以来已攀升
    • 🫧 例句 Public confidence has climbedsince the new policy was implemented.
    • 🌈 同义 has risen since

fewer than

  • 💫 释义 少于 ( 用于可数名词 )
    • 🫧 例句 Fewer than tenstudents attended the lecture.
    • 🌈 同义 less than ( 用于可数名词 )

go off

  • 💫 释义 ( 炸弹 ) 爆炸; ( 警报 ) 响起; 突然发出巨响
    • 🫧 例句 The fire alarm wentoff in the middle of the night.
    • 🌈 同义 explode, sound loudly
  • 💫 释义 ( 食物 ) 变质, 坏掉
    • 🫧 例句 The milk has gone off;don’t drink it.
    • 🌈 同义 spoil, go bad
  • 💫 释义 离开 ( 去做某事 ); 进展
    • 🫧 例句 She went off to starther own business. / The event went offsmoothly.
    • 🌈 同义 depart, proceed

send out

  • 💫 释义 发出, 发送 ( 信号、邀请、邮件等 )
    • 🫧 例句 The company sent out apress release to all major media.
    • 🌈 同义 dispatch, issue, distribute
  • 💫 释义 派遣 ( 人员 )
    • 🫧 例句 The UN decided to sendout a peacekeeping force.
    • 🌈 同义 deploy, dispatch

send out for

  • 💫 释义 打电话订购 ( 外卖、货物 )
    • 🫧 例句 Let’s send out forpizza tonight.
    • 🌈 同义 order in, have delivered

other than

  • 💫 释义 除了; 不同于
    • 🫧 例句 There’s no one here otherthan me.
    • 🌈 同义 except, apart from
  • 💫 释义 除了…之外 ( 用于否定句 )
    • 🫧 例句 She has no income otherthan her salary.
    • 🌈 同义 besides, aside from

to begin with

  • 💫 释义 首先, 第一 ( 用于列举理由或要点 )
    • 🫧 例句 To begin with, we needto clarify the project’s main objective.
    • 🌈 同义 firstly, in the first place
  • 💫 释义 起初, 一开始
    • 🫧 例句 There were only a few membersto begin with.
    • 🌈 同义 at the start, initially

match with

  • 💫 释义 与…相配/相适合
    • 🫧 例句 Your tie matchesperfectly with your shirt.
    • 🌈 同义 go well with, complement
  • 💫 释义 为…找到相配的人或物
    • 🫧 例句 The program matchesvolunteers with local schools.
    • 🌈 同义 pair with, connect

be matched with

  • 💫 释义 被安排与…对应/比较
    • 🫧 例句 In the study, participants werematched with a control group.
    • 🌈 同义 be paired with, be alignedwith

tipping point

  • 💫 释义 临界点, 转折点 (指引发重大、不可逆变化的微小积累的最终节点 )
    • 🫧 例句 The scandal was the tippingpoint that led to the CEO’s resignation.
    • 🌈 同义 turning point, breaking point, criticaljuncture

Part 35

all life on Earth

  • 💫 释义 地球上的一切生命
    • 🫧 例句 Climate change is a threat toall life on Earth.
    • 🌈 同义 every living thing on the planet, theentirety of Earth’s biosphere
  • 💫 释义 地球众生 ( 常用于生态、哲学语境 )
    • 🫧 例句 This discovery could change how weunderstand all life on Earth.
    • 🌈 同义 the whole of Earth’s life, the entirebiological world

such…that…

  • 💫 释义 如此…以至于… ( 引导结果状语从句 )
    • 🫧 例句 It was such a goodfilm that I watched it twice.
    • 🌈 同义 so…that… ( 修饰形容词或副词 )
  • 💫 释义 这样…的 ( 事物 ) 以至于…
    • 🫧 例句 He spoke with suchpassion that the audience was captivated.
    • 🌈 同义 to the extent that
  • 💫 释义 如此大的…以至于…
    • 🫧 例句 There was such a longqueue that we decided to come back later.
    • 🌈 同义 a very…so that

slip from

  • 💫 释义 从…滑落; 从…脱离
    • 🫧 例句 The glass slipped fromher hand and shattered on the floor.
    • 🌈 同义 fall from, drop from
  • 💫 释义 ( 从记忆、意识中 ) 消失, 被遗忘
    • 🫧 例句 The details of the event haveslipped from my memory.
    • 🌈 同义 fade from, escape from

slip from view

  • 💫 释义 从视线中消失
    • 🫧 例句 The boat slipped fromview behind the fog.
    • 🌈 同义 disappear from sight

not a moment too soon

  • 💫 释义 正是时候, 毫不嫌早 ( 强调某事早该发生 )
    • 🫧 例句 The ambulance arrived, not amoment too soon.
    • 🌈 同义 just in time, none too soon
  • 💫 释义 来得刚好 ( 带庆幸语气 )
    • 🫧 例句 The rain started just as we got home—not a moment too soon !
    • 🌈 同义 in the nick of time
  • 💫 释义 早该如此 ( 对迟来事物的评价 )
    • 🫧 例句 This policy reform comes not amoment too soon for the struggling industry.
    • 🌈 同义 long overdue, highly timely

for sb to do sth

  • 💫 释义 由某人做某事 ( 作主语、表语、宾语等 )
    • 🫧 例句 For him to admit amistake is very difficult.
    • 🌈 同义 that sb should do sth
  • 💫 释义 让某人做某事 ( 与形容词连用 )
    • 🫧 例句 This book is too difficult fora child to understand.
    • 🌈 同义 ( used after adjectives )
  • 💫 释义 供某人做某事 ( 作定语 )
    • 🫧 例句 There’s a lot of work for us tofinish today.
    • 🌈 同义 that sb needs to do

responded to… by…

  • 💫 释义 通过…方式来应对/回应…
    • 🫧 例句 The company respondedto the crisis by implementing new safetyprotocols.
    • 🌈 同义 reacted to… by…, answered…by…
  • 💫 释义 以…行动作为对…的回应
    • 🫧 例句 She responded to thechallenge by working even harder.
    • 🌈 同义 met… with the action of…
  • 💫 释义 针对…采取了…行动
    • 🫧 例句 The government respondedto public pressure by launching aninvestigation.
    • 🌈 同义 addressed… through the meansof…

turn…green

  • 💫 释义 使…变绿 ( 指绿化 )
    • 🫧 例句 The community project aims toturn the vacant lot green.
    • 🌈 同义 make…green, greenify
  • 💫 释义 使…变得环保
    • 🫧 例句 New technology can helpturn the industry green.
    • 🌈 同义 make…environmentally friendly

turn green

  • 💫 释义 变绿; 脸色变得苍白 ( 带绿色, 指身体不适 )
    • 🫧 例句 The leaves turn greenin spring. / His face turned green after the rollercoaster ride.
    • 🌈 同义 become green, look pale andsickly

war on

  • 💫 释义 对…的战争, 打击…的行动
    • 🫧 例句 The government declared a waron drugs.
    • 🌈 同义 campaign against, crackdownon
  • 💫 释义 针对…的大规模斗争
    • 🫧 例句 The organization is committed to thewar on poverty.
    • 🌈 同义 battle against, fight against
  • 💫 释义 消除…的运动
    • 🫧 例句 The city launched a waron graffiti.
    • 🌈 同义 offensive against, assault on

Part 36

apart from

  • 💫 释义 除了…之外 ( 都 )
    • 🫧 例句 Apart from a fewscratches, the car is in good condition.
    • 🌈 同义 except for, other than
  • 💫 释义 除了…之外 ( 还 )
    • 🫧 例句 Apart from English, hespeaks French and Japanese.
    • 🌈 同义 in addition to, besides
  • 💫 释义 脱离, 远离
    • 🫧 例句 He stood apart fromthe crowd, watching silently.
    • 🌈 同义 separate from, away from

defence against

  • 💫 释义 对…的防御; 针对…的防护
    • 🫧 例句 Vaccination is the best defenceagainst the virus.
    • 🌈 同义 protection from, safeguardagainst
  • 💫 释义 抵御…的手段
    • 🫧 例句 A strong immune system is your body’sdefence against infection.
    • 🌈 同义 resistance to, barrieragainst
  • 💫 释义 为…辩护
    • 🫧 例句 The lawyer’s defenceagainst the accusations was very convincing.
    • 🌈 同义 justification for, argument in responseto

different from

  • 💫 释义 与…不同
    • 🫧 例句 His approach is differentfrom mine.
    • 🌈 同义 distinct from, unlike
  • 💫 释义 区别于…
    • 🫧 例句 The final product was differentfrom the original design.
    • 🌈 同义 not the same as
  • 💫 释义 与…有差异
    • 🫧 例句 Life in the country is verydifferent from life in the city.
    • 🌈 同义 dissimilar to

have…in common with…

  • 💫 释义 与…有共同之处
    • 🫧 例句 The two cultures havemany traditions in common with each other.
    • 🌈 同义 share…with…, be similarto…in…
  • 💫 释义 与…共享…
    • 🫧 例句 I have nothingin common with my roommate.
    • 🌈 同义 possess mutual…with…
  • 💫 释义 与…在…上相似
    • 🫧 例句 This theory has somekey points in common with earlier research.
    • 🌈 同义 resemble…in aspects of…

in response to

  • 💫 释义 作为对…的回应
    • 🫧 例句 The company lowered its pricesin response to customer feedback.
    • 🌈 同义 reacting to, as a reply to
  • 💫 释义 针对…而采取的行动
    • 🫧 例句 In response to thecrisis, the government issued new guidelines.
    • 🌈 同义 answering, addressing
  • 💫 释义 应…而作出
    • 🫧 例句 This program was created inresponse to market demands.
    • 🌈 同义 as a result of, due to

roll out

  • 💫 释义 正式推出 ( 新产品、服务 )
    • 🫧 例句 The company will rollout the new software next month.
    • 🌈 同义 launch, introduce
  • 💫 释义 铺开, 实施 ( 计划、政策 )
    • 🫧 例句 The new policy will be rolledout nationwide.
    • 🌈 同义 implement, deploy
  • 💫 释义 展开, 铺开 ( 物理物件 )
    • 🫧 例句 They rolled out thered carpet for the important guests.
    • 🌈 同义 unfold, spread out

meet expectations

  • 💫 释义 达到期望, 符合预期
    • 🫧 例句 The new product metexpectations and sold well.
    • 🌈 同义 fulfill expectations, satisfyexpectations
  • 💫 释义 如愿以偿
