    • 🫧 例句 Plastic takes centuries tobreak down in nature.
    • 🌈 同义 decompose, disintegrate
  • 💫 释义 破除, 消除 ( 障碍 )
    • 🫧 例句 We need to break downthese communication barriers.
    • 🌈 同义 eliminate, remove

one of the biggestcontributors

  • 💫 释义 最主要的促成因素之一
    • 🫧 例句 Transportation is one of thebiggest contributors to air pollution.
    • 🌈 同义 a major cause of, a primary factorin
  • 💫 释义 最重要的贡献者之一
    • 🫧 例句 She was one of the biggestcontributors to the project’s success.
    • 🌈 同义 a key player in, a significantparticipant in
  • 💫 释义 主要来源之一
    • 🫧 例句 Deforestation is one of thebiggest contributors to climate change.
    • 🌈 同义 a main source of, a leading causeof

entry.title: 固定搭配-3
entry.content:
说明

  • 💫 释义 ( Meaning )
  • 🫧 例句 ( Example )
  • 🌈 同义 ( Synonym )

本文章较长，可通过 目录 或 ctrl +F 搜索.

Part 21

take the plunge

  • 💫 释义 决定冒险一试 ( 尤指经过深思熟虑后 )
    • 🫧 例句 After years of hesitation, they finallytook the plunge and got married.
    • 🌈 同义 take a bold step, commitoneself

take by surprise

  • 💫 释义 使吃惊, 出乎意料
    • 🫧 例句 The sudden storm tookall the hikers by surprise.
    • 🌈 同义 astonish, catch off guard,shock

take the floor

  • 💫 释义 发言
    • 🫧 例句 The chairman took thefloor to begin the conference.
    • 🌈 同义 speak, address the audience

take a back seat

  • 💫 释义 处于次要地位, 退居二线
    • 🫧 例句 As he neared retirement, he began totake a back seat in company decisions.
    • 🌈 同义 assume a less active role,withdraw

take the cake

  • 💫 释义 成为最佳/最差者 ( 常含讽刺 )
    • 🫧 例句 Of all his crazy ideas, this one reallytakes the cake.
    • 🌈 同义 be the most extreme, be thelimit

take the edge off

  • 💫 释义 减弱, 使缓和
    • 🫧 例句 A cup of tea might take theedge off your headache.
    • 🌈 同义 reduce, alleviate, soften

take a rain check

  • 💫 释义 改期, 下次再说
    • 🫧 例句 I can’t make it tonight - can Itake a rain check ?
    • 🌈 同义 postpone, reschedule

take the wordsright out of someone’s mouth

  • 💫 释义 说出某人正想说的话
    • 🫧 例句 You took the words right out ofmy mouth - I completely agree.
    • 🌈 同义 express someone’s exactthoughts

take a hike

  • 💫 释义 走开, 离开 ( 常作命令式, 不礼貌 )
    • 🫧 例句 When he refused to leave, she told himto take a hike.
    • 🌈 同义 go away, get lost, beat it

take a leaf out ofsomeone’s book

  • 💫 释义 效仿某人
    • 🫧 例句 You should take a leaf out ofyour sister’s book and study harder.
    • 🌈 同义 imitate, emulate, follow someone’sexample

Part 22

take five

  • 💫 释义 休息五分钟, 稍作休息
    • 🫧 例句 We’ve been working hard all morning -let’s take five.
    • 🌈 同义 take a short break, pause for amoment

take someone to thecleaners

  • 💫 释义 骗光某人的钱
    • 🫧 例句 In the divorce settlement, she reallytook him to the cleaners.
    • 🌈 同义 cheat out of money, financiallyruin

take the bull by thehorns

  • 💫 释义 果断处理难题
    • 🫧 例句 Instead of avoiding the problem, hedecided to take the bull by the horns.
    • 🌈 同义 confront directly, tacklehead-on

take with a grain ofsalt

  • 💫 释义 对…半信半疑, 有所保留地听
    • 🫧 例句 You should take hisstories with a grain of salt - he tends toexaggerate.
    • 🌈 同义 view skeptically, not takeliterally

take someone under yourwing

  • 💫 释义 照顾提携某人
    • 🫧 例句 The experienced lawyer took theyoung graduate under her wing.
    • 🌈 同义 mentor, guide, protect

take the wind out ofsomeone’s sails

  • 💫 释义 挫败某人的锐气
    • 🫧 例句 Losing the first round took thewind out of the champion’s sails.
    • 🌈 同义 deflate, discourage,dishearten

take forty winks

  • 💫 释义 小睡, 打盹
    • 🫧 例句 I’m just going to take fortywinks before we go out tonight.
    • 🌈 同义 nap briefly, have a shortsleep

take off

  • 💫 释义 起飞; 突然成功; 脱下
    • 🫧 例句 The plane will takeoff in ten minutes. / Her career really tookoff after that movie.
    • 🌈 同义 become airborne; become successful;remove

take after

  • 💫 释义 长得像; 行为像 ( 长辈 )
    • 🫧 例句 She takes after hermother in both looks and personality.
    • 🌈 同义 resemble, be similar to

take over

  • 💫 释义 接管, 接手
    • 🫧 例句 The son will take overthe family business when his father retires.
    • 🌈 同义 assume control of, take chargeof

Part 23

take up

  • 💫 释义 开始从事; 占据 ( 时间/空间 )
    • 🫧 例句 He has taken upphotography as a hobby. / This sofa takes up too muchspace.
    • 🌈 同义 begin, start; occupy, fill

take on

  • 💫 释义 承担; 呈现; 雇佣
    • 🫧 例句 She didn’t want to takeon more responsibilities at work.
    • 🌈 同义 undertake, accept; assume;hire

take down

  • 💫 释义 记下; 拆除
    • 🫧 例句 Please take down theseimportant points. / They will take down the oldbuilding next week.
    • 🌈 同义 write down, record; dismantle,demolish

take in

  • 💫 释义 理解; 欺骗; 收容
    • 🫧 例句 It was hard to take inall the information at once. / She was taken in by hissmooth talking.
    • 🌈 同义 comprehend, absorb; deceive;shelter

take back

  • 💫 释义 收回 ( 话语 ); 退还 ( 商品 )
    • 🫧 例句 I take back what Isaid about him - he’s actually very kind.
    • 🌈 同义 retract, withdraw; return

take out

  • 💫 释义 取出; 带…出去; 消灭
    • 🫧 例句 He took out his walletto pay the bill. / I’m taking my parentsout for dinner.
    • 🌈 同义 extract, remove; entertain;eliminate

take away

  • 💫 释义 带走; 减去; 外卖
    • 🫧 例句 The police took himaway for questioning. / What’s 15 takeaway 7?
    • 🌈 同义 remove, carry off; subtract

take to

  • 💫 释义 开始喜欢; 养成…习惯
    • 🫧 例句 She didn’t take to hernew boss immediately. / He’s taken to jogging everymorning.
    • 🌈 同义 develop a liking for; begin ahabit

take aback

  • 💫 释义 使吃惊, 使困惑
    • 🫧 例句 I was rather takenaback by his rude response.
    • 🌈 同义 surprise, astonish, shock

take for

  • 💫 释义 误认为是
    • 🫧 例句 I often take herfor her sister - they look so much alike.
    • 🌈 同义 mistake for, confuse with

Part 24

take against

  • 💫 释义 不喜欢, 反对
    • 🫧 例句 For some reason, the dog tookagainst the postman immediately.
    • 🌈 同义 dislike, form a dislike for

take apart

  • 💫 释义 拆开, 拆卸
    • 🫧 例句 The mechanic took theengine apart to find the problem.
    • 🌈 同义 disassemble, dismantle

take along

  • 💫 释义 随身携带
    • 🫧 例句 Don’t forget to takealong your passport when you travel abroad.
    • 🌈 同义 bring with one, carry along

take aside

  • 💫 释义 把…叫到一旁说话
    • 🫧 例句 The teacher took thestudent aside to discuss his behavior.
    • 🌈 同义 speak to privately, pullaside

take through

  • 💫 释义 引导, 讲解
    • 🫧 例句 Let me take youthrough the main points of the proposal.
    • 🌈 同义 guide through, explain step bystep

take upon oneself

  • 💫 释义 主动承担 ( 责任 )
    • 🫧 例句 She took it uponherself to organize the office party.
    • 🌈 同义 assume responsibilityvoluntarily

bring about

  • 💫 释义 引起, 导致
    • 🫧 例句 The new policy broughtabout significant changes in the industry.
    • 🌈 同义 cause something to happen

bring up

  • 💫 释义 提出; 养育
    • 🫧 例句 She brought up animportant point during the meeting.
    • 🌈 同义 mention a topic; raise achild

bring out

  • 💫 释义 使显现; 出版
    • 🫧 例句 The crisis brought outthe best in him.
    • 🌈 同义 reveal a quality; publish abook

bring forward

  • 💫 释义 提出; 提前
    • 🫧 例句 He brought forward anew proposal.
    • 🌈 同义 present an idea; move to an earliertime

Part 25

bring down

  • 💫 释义 降低; 推翻
    • 🫧 例句 The scandal broughtdown the government.
    • 🌈 同义 reduce something; cause tofall

bring along

  • 💫 释义 带来; 促进成长
    • 🫧 例句 You can bring along afriend to the party.
    • 🌈 同义 bring someone or something with you;help someone develop

bring off

  • 💫 释义 成功完成
    • 🫧 例句 It was a difficult task, but shebrought it off.
    • 🌈 同义 succeed in doing somethingdifficult

thanks to

  • 💫 释义 由于, 多亏
    • 🫧 例句 Thanks to your help,we finished the project on time.
    • 🌈 同义 because of, with the help of

no thanks to

  • 💫 释义 并非由于 ( 尽管有阻碍 )
    • 🫧 例句 We managed to arrive on time,no thanks to the terrible traffic.
    • 🌈 同义 despite, not assisted by

blame for

  • 💫 释义 因…责备, 归咎于
    • 🫧 例句 You can’t blame himfor the accident.
    • 🌈 同义 hold responsible for a fault

be to blame for

  • 💫 释义 对…应负责任
    • 🫧 例句 The faulty wiring is to blamefor the fire.
    • 🌈 同义 be responsible for somethingbad

in charge of

  • 💫 释义 负责, 掌管
    • 🫧 例句 She is in charge ofthe marketing department.
    • 🌈 同义 having responsibility for or controlover

free of charge

  • 💫 释义 免费
    • 🫧 例句 The samples were provided freeof charge.
    • 🌈 同义 without any cost

charge with

  • 💫 释义 指控, 控告
    • 🫧 例句 The man was chargedwith robbery.
    • 🌈 同义 accuse formally of a crime

Part 26

take charge

  • 💫 释义 开始管理, 接管
    • 🫧 例句 When the manager fell ill, herassistant had to take charge.
    • 🌈 同义 assume control or command

charge for

  • 💫 释义 为…收费
    • 🫧 例句 How much do you chargefor a haircut?
    • 🌈 同义 ask in payment for

be charged with

  • 💫 释义 被指控; 被赋予 ( 责任 )
    • 🫧 例句 He was charged withmurder. / The committee is charged with investigatingthe incident.
    • 🌈 同义 be accused of a crime; be given a dutyor responsibility

charge at

  • 💫 释义 冲向, 向…冲去
    • 🫧 例句 The bull charged atthe matador.
    • 🌈 同义 rush forward in attack

on a charge of

  • 💫 释义 因…罪名而被控
    • 🫧 例句 He was arrested on a chargeof theft.
    • 🌈 同义 being accused with a specificcrime

put in charge of

  • 💫 释义 被任命负责
    • 🫧 例句 She was put in chargeof the new project.
    • 🌈 同义 be given responsibility for

under the charge of

  • 💫 释义 在…的掌管之下
    • 🫧 例句 The department is under thecharge of MrSmith.
    • 🌈 同义 under the management or supervisionof

play a role in

  • 💫 释义 在…中扮演角色; 在…中起作用
    • 🫧 例句 Education plays a crucial rolein shaping one’s future.
    • 🌈 同义 to be involved in and have an effecton

have a role in

  • 💫 释义 在…中有一份职责; 参与
    • 🫧 例句 She has a key role inthe upcoming project.
    • 🌈 同义 to have a function or responsibilityin

far away from

  • 💫 释义 离…很远
    • 🫧 例句 The village is far awayfrom the noisy city.
    • 🌈 同义 at a great distance from

Part 27

break away from

  • 💫 释义 脱离; 摆脱
    • 🫧 例句 The province sought to breakaway from the central government.
    • 🌈 同义 to escape from or leave someone orsomething

turn away from

  • 💫 释义 对…感到厌恶; 回避
    • 🫧 例句 He turned away fromthe violent scene in disgust.
    • 🌈 同义 to stop supporting or being involvedwith

get away from

  • 💫 释义 逃离; 摆脱
    • 🫧 例句 She decided to get awayfrom her stressful job for a while.
    • 🌈 同义 to leave or escape from a person orplace

as … put it

  • 💫 释义 正如…所说/所言
    • 🫧 例句 The situation was, as thechairman put it, “a grave threat to nationalsecurity”.
    • 🌈 同义 in the words of…, to quote…, as… said,phrasing it in the words of…

news feed

  • 💫 释义 信息流; 新闻推送
    • 🫧 例句 I scroll through my social medianews feed every morning to catch up onupdates.
    • 🌈 同义 social media feed, timeline, stream,updates

go through

  • 💫 释义 经历, 遭受 ( 困难或不快的事 )
    • 🫧 例句 She went through a lotof difficulties after losing her job.
    • 🌈 同义 experience, endure, undergo,suffer
  • 💫 释义 仔细检查; 翻阅
    • 🫧 例句 The lawyer wentthrough all the documents carefully before the trial.
    • 🌈 同义 examine, check, look through,scrutinize
  • 💫 释义 通过, 被批准
    • 🫧 例句 We’re waiting for our planningpermission to go through.
    • 🌈 同义 be approved, be accepted, beratified
  • 💫 释义 用完, 耗尽
    • 🫧 例句 We went through awhole jar of coffee in just one week.
    • 🌈 同义 use up, consume, exhaust, runthrough

expect sth of sb

  • 💫 释义 对某人抱有…的期望
    • 🫧 例句 The teacher expects hard workof all her students.
    • 🌈 同义 to require or demand something fromsomeone; to have expectations of someone

account for

  • 💫 释义 解释, 说明 ( 原因或理由 )
    • 🫧 例句 How do you account forthe sudden drop in sales?
    • 🌈 同义 explain, give an explanation for,justify
  • 💫 释义 占 ( 比例、数量 )
    • 🫧 例句 Overseas sales accountfor over 60% of our total revenue.
    • 🌈 同义 constitute, make up, represent,comprise
  • 💫 释义 说明 ( 去向 ), 对…负责
    • 🫧 例句 All the missing files have now beenaccounted for.
    • 🌈 同义 explain the whereabouts of, give arecord of
  • 💫 释义 ( 在战斗、事故中 ) 摧毁, 杀死
    • 🫧 例句 The fighter pilot accountedfor three enemy aircraft.
    • 🌈 同义 | shoot down, eliminate, takeout

on account of

  • 💫 释义 由于, 因为
    • 🫧 例句 The match was postponed onaccount of the bad weather.
    • 🌈 同义 because of, due to, owing to

take into account

  • 💫 释义 考虑; 顾及
    • 🫧 例句 The judge took thedefendant’s age into account when passingsentence.
    • 🌈 同义 consider, take into consideration, bearin mind

Part 28

by all accounts

  • 💫 释义 根据各方面的说法; 大家都说
    • 🫧 例句 By all accounts, he isan excellent and dedicated teacher.
    • 🌈 同义 from what everyone says, reportedly, byall reports

call sb to account

  • 💫 释义 要求某人作出解释; 追究某人的责任
    • 🫧 例句 The public is demanding that thegovernment be called to account for its handling of thecrisis.
    • 🌈 同义 | hold someone accountable, demand anexplanation from someone

settle accounts with sb

  • 💫 释义 与某人结清账目;
    ( 引申义 )与某人算账/报仇
    • 🫧 例句 He returned to the city tosettle accounts with his former partner.
    • 🌈 同义 | get even with, get back at, squareaccounts with

a blow-by-blow account

  • 💫 释义 ( 对事件 ) 极为详尽的叙述
    • 🫧 例句 She gave us a blow-by-blowaccount of everything that happened at the meeting.
    • 🌈 同义 a detailed description, aminute-by-minute report

go by

  • 💫 释义 ( 时间 ) 流逝, 过去
    • 🫧 例句 As time goes by,memories of the event begin to fade.
    • 🌈 同义 ( of time ) to pass or elapse
  • 💫 释义 遵循, 依据
    • 🫧 例句 When making important decisions, it’sbest to go by the official guidelines.
    • 🌈 同义 to be guided by, to follow theprinciples of
  • 💫 释义 经过, 路过
    • 🫧 例句 I saw a delivery truck goby my office window just now.
    • 🌈 同义 to pass ( a place )
  • 💫 释义 以…名字为人所知
    • 🫧 例句 His passport says “Robert”, but hegoes by “Bobby”.
    • 🌈 同义 to be known by a particularname

approach… in… ways

  • 💫 释义 以…方式对待/处理…
    • 🫧 例句 Different cultures approach theconcept of time in fundamentally different ways.
    • 🌈 同义 tackle… using… methods, handle…through… approaches, address… from… perspectives

committed to

  • 💫 释义 致力于; 投身于
    • 🫧 例句 The company is committedto providing the highest quality of service.
    • 🌈 同义 dedicated to, devoted to, pledgedto

dedicated to

  • 💫 释义 专注于; 献身于
    • 🫧 例句 She is dedicated tohelping underprivileged children in her community.
    • 🌈 同义 devoted to, committed to, focusedon

devoted to

  • 💫 释义 奉献给; 忠于
    • 🫧 例句 He has a section in his librarydevoted to historical biographies.
    • 🌈 同义 dedicated to, reserved for, committedto

get up to speed

  • 💫 释义 使熟悉情况; 跟上进度
    • 🫧 例句 The new manager spent her first weekgetting up to speed with the company’sprojects.
    • 🌈 同义 to reach a required standard ofefficiency or knowledge, to become current or informed

Part 29

bring sb/sth up to speed

  • 💫 释义 使某人/某事物熟悉情况; 使跟上进度
    • 🫧 例句 Can you bring me up tospeed on what was decided at the meeting?
    • 🌈 同义 to provide someone with the latestinformation, to make something modern or efficient

pearls of wisdom

  • 💫 释义 智慧的结晶; 精辟的见解 ( 常带幽默或讽刺 )
    • 🫧 例句 We gathered around the old sailor,eager to hear his pearls of wisdom about life atsea.
    • 🌈 同义 wise and insightful remarks, words ofwisdom ( often used humorously )

out there

  • 💫 释义 存在的; 可获得的; 在外部世界的
    • 🫧 例句 There are many great opportunitiesout there if you know where to look.
    • 🌈 同义 in existence, available, in the widerworld
  • 💫 释义 另类的; 非传统的
    • 🫧 例句 His latest artistic creation is reallyout there and hard for most people tounderstand.
    • 🌈 同义 unconventional, avant-garde,eccentric

prevent the need for

  • 💫 释义 避免对…的需求; 防患于未然
    • 🫧 例句 Regular maintenance can preventthe need for costly repairs in the future.
    • 🌈 同义 avoid the necessity of, make somethingunnecessary, obviate the requirement for

It is A more than B

  • 💫 释义 与其说是B, 不如说是A
    • 🫧 例句 His success was a result ofluck more than careful planning.
    • 🌈 同义 rather A than B, not so much B asA

It is less B, more A

  • 💫 释义 与其说是B, 不如说是A ( 另一种强调说法 )
    • 🫧 例句 The room’s style was lessformal, more cozy and inviting.
    • 🌈 同义 better described as A rather thanB

not so much B as A

  • 💫 释义 与其说是B, 不如说是A
    • 🫧 例句 He is not so much a genius as avery hard worker.
    • 🌈 同义 it would be more accurate to say A thanB

stick to

  • 💫 释义 坚持; 遵守
    • 🫧 例句 If you stick to yourstudy plan, you will see good results.
    • 🌈 同义 adhere to, persist with, keep to, abideby

stick with

  • 💫 释义 继续坚持; 不放弃
    • 🫧 例句 Learning a language is hard, butstick with it and you’ll get there.
    • 🌈 同义 continue with, persevere with, notabandon

day in and day out

  • 💫 释义 日复一日; 一天又一天 ( 常指单调重复 )
    • 🫧 例句 She practiced the piano day inand day out to prepare for the competition.
    • 🌈 同义 every day without exception,continuously and often monotonously

Part 30

day after day

  • 💫 释义 一天又一天 ( 强调重复和时间的流逝 )
    • 🫧 例句 Day after day, thescientists conducted the same experiment, hoping for abreakthrough.
    • 🌈 同义 for many days in succession, repeatedlyover time

all year round

  • 💫 释义 一年到头; 全年
    • 🫧 例句 The swimming pool is open allyear round.
    • 🌈 同义 throughout the entire year, in everyseason

work on

  • 💫 释义 致力于; 努力做 ( 改进、完成某事 )
    • 🫧 例句 She is working on anew novel these days.
    • 🌈 同义 be engaged in, devote effort to, applyoneself to
  • 💫 释义 努力说服或影响
    • 🫧 例句 I’ll work on my fatherto let us use the car tonight.
    • 🌈 同义 try to persuade or influence
  • 💫 释义 对…产生作用/影响
    • 🫧 例句 This medicine works onthe central nervous system.
    • 🌈 同义 have an effect on, act upon

one day at a time

  • 💫 释义 一次一天; 循序渐进
    • 🫧 例句 Dealing with a big project can beoverwhelming, so just take it one day at atime.
    • 🌈 同义 dealing with each day’s problems asthey come, without worrying about the future

step by step

  • 💫 释义 一步一步地; 逐步地
    • 🫧 例句 Let’s approach this complex problemstep by step.
    • 🌈 同义 gradually and methodically, proceedingone stage at a time

little by little

  • 💫 释义 一点一点地; 逐渐地
    • 🫧 例句 Little by little, herEnglish improved through daily practice.
    • 🌈 同义 gradually, by small degrees, bit bybit

avoid doing sth

  • 💫 释义 避免做某事
    • 🫧 例句 You should avoidmaking the same mistake again.
    • 🌈 同义 refrain from doing, keep fromdoing

avoid the issue/topic

  • 💫 释义 回避问题/话题
    • 🫧 例句 He always avoids theissue when I ask about his plans.
    • 🌈 同义 evade, sidestep, skirt around

avoid like the plague

  • 💫 释义 像避瘟疫一样避开; 极力避免
    • 🫧 例句 After the scandal, everyoneavoided him like the plague.
    • 🌈 同义 stay completely away from,shun

take action

  • 💫 释义 采取行动
    • 🫧 例句 We must take actionbefore it’s too late.
    • 🌈 同义 act, do something

entry.title: 固定搭配-2
entry.content:
说明

  • 💫 释义 ( Meaning )
  • 🫧 例句 ( Example )
  • 🌈 同义 ( Synonym )

本文章较长，可通过 目录 或 ctrl +F 搜索.

Part 11

address a meeting

  • 💫 释义 在会议上发言
    • 🫧 例句 The CEO will address theshareholders’ meeting this afternoon.
    • 🌈 同义 speak at a meeting, give a speechto

address the audience

  • 💫 释义 向观众致辞
    • 🫧 例句 Before starting his speech, headdressed the audience briefly.
    • 🌈 同义 speak to the audience, make an addressto

address a letter

  • 💫 释义 在信件上写地址
    • 🫧 例句 Please make sure you addressthe envelope correctly.
    • 🌈 同义 write the address on, direct a letterto

address concerns

  • 💫 释义 回应关切
    • 🫧 例句 The company needs to addresscustomers’ concerns about privacy.
    • 🌈 同义 respond to concerns, allay worries,answer questions

address oneself to

  • 💫 释义 致力于; 着手处理
    • 🫧 例句 We should address ourselvesto the main task at hand.
    • 🌈 同义 apply oneself to, devote oneself to,attend to

address a problem

  • 💫 释义 解决问题
    • 🫧 例句 The new software addresses theproblem of slow data processing.
    • 🌈 同义 solve a problem, fix an issue, resolvea matter

address needs

  • 💫 释义 满足需求
    • 🫧 例句 The program is designed toaddress the specific needs of elderly users.
    • 🌈 同义 meet needs, fulfill requirements, caterto

address the imbalance

  • 💫 释义 纠正不平衡
    • 🫧 例句 New policies are needed toaddress the economic imbalance.
    • 🌈 同义 correct the imbalance, redress thedisparity, restore balance

drop out

  • 💫 释义 退出, 退学, 辍学
    • 🫧 例句 He had to drop out ofthe race due to an injury.
    • 🌈 同义 withdraw, quit, leave

drop in

  • 💫 释义 顺便拜访, 突然造访
    • 🫧 例句 Feel free to drop infor a cup of tea anytime.
    • 🌈 同义 stop by, come over, pop in

Part 12

drop off

  • 💫 释义 放下 ( 某人或某物 ); 减少, 下降
    • 🫧 例句 I’ll drop youoff at the station. / Sales have droppedoff recently.
    • 🌈 同义 deliver, leave; decrease,decline

drop behind

  • 💫 释义 落后, 落在后面
    • 🫧 例句 She dropped behind inher studies after being ill.
    • 🌈 同义 fall behind, lag behind

drop it

  • 💫 释义 停止谈论 ( 某事 ), 放下 ( 话题 )
    • 🫧 例句 I don’t want to talk about thisanymore, just drop it.
    • 🌈 同义 let it go, stop talking aboutit

as part of

  • 💫 释义 作为…的一部分
    • 🫧 例句 She was invited to join the committeeas part of the new initiative.
    • 🌈 同义 within the framework of, as a componentof, under the umbrella of

on strike

  • 💫 释义 罢工, 罢工中
    • 🫧 例句 The workers have been onstrike for two weeks demanding better pay.
    • 🌈 同义 taking industrial action, walkingout

strike in

  • 💫 释义 插嘴
    • 🫧 例句 He always strikes inwith unwanted comments during our meetings.
    • 🌈 同义 interrupt, cut in, break in

air strike

  • 💫 释义 空袭
    • 🫧 例句 The UN called for an immediate end tothe air strikes in the region.
    • 🌈 同义 aerial attack, bombing raid

strike at

  • 💫 释义 袭击; 攻击; 向…打击
    • 🫧 例句 The new policy strikesat the root cause of poverty in the community.
    • 🌈 同义 attack, assault, aim at

lightning strike

  • 💫 释义 雷击; 闪电式罢工
    • 🫧 例句 The tree was split in half by alightning strike. / The lightningstrike paralyzed the city’s transportation.
    • 🌈 同义 thunderbolt; wildcat strike

strike for

  • 💫 释义 为…而罢工
    • 🫧 例句 The employees are prepared tostrike for better working conditions.
    • 🌈 同义 walk out for, take industrial actionfor

Part 13

strike down

  • 💫 释义 杀死; 击倒; [法律]宣布无效
    • 🫧 例句 The disease struckdown many young children. / The court struckdown the controversial law.
    • 🌈 同义 kill, defeat; invalidate,annul

go on strike

  • 💫 释义 举行罢工
    • 🫧 例句 The teachers voted to go onstrike next month if their demands aren’t met.
    • 🌈 同义 walk out, take strike action

strike a chord

  • 💫 释义 引起共鸣, 触动心弦
    • 🫧 例句 His speech about equalitystruck a chord with the younger generation.
    • 🌈 同义 resonate with, connect with, touch anerve

strike against

  • 💫 释义 为反对…而罢工
    • 🫧 例句 The workers are strikingagainst the proposed layoffs and pay cuts.
    • 🌈 同义 protest against, walk outagainst

strike on

  • 💫 释义 打在…上; 突然想起
    • 🫧 例句 The rain was strikingon the window pane. / I finally struck on asolution to the problem.
    • 🌈 同义 hit, beat upon; come up with, hitupon

strike up

  • 💫 释义 使开始; 建立起; 开始演奏
    • 🫧 例句 It’s easy to strike upa conversation with him. / The band struck up afamiliar tune.
    • 🌈 同义 begin, start; commenceplaying

strike out

  • 💫 释义 打击; 删去; 想出; 独立创业
    • 🫧 例句 **
      1. He struck out three batters in a row.
      1. She decided to strike out on her own and start abusiness.
    • 🌈 同义 cross out, delete; set out, ventureforth

strike fire

  • 💫 释义 打火
    • 🫧 例句 It took several attempts tostrike fire with the damp matches.
    • 🌈 同义 ignite, kindle, light

strike someone as

  • 💫 释义 在某人看来似乎…
    • 🫧 例句 The proposal strikes meas being somewhat impractical and unrealistic.
    • 🌈 同义 impress someone as, appear tosomeone

strike back

  • 💫 释义 回击, 反击
    • 🫧 例句 After weeks of criticism, the companydecided to strike back with a strong publicstatement.
    • 🌈 同义 retaliate, fight back,counterattack

Part 14

ramp up

  • 💫 释义 增加, 提升 ( 规模、数量或强度 )
    • 🫧 例句 The company plans to rampup production to meet the growing demand.
    • 🌈 同义 increase, scale up, boost,intensify

ramp up efforts

  • 💫 释义 加大努力
    • 🫧 例句 We need to ramp up ourefforts to complete the project on schedule.
    • 🌈 同义 intensify efforts, increase endeavors,step up actions

ramp up production

  • 💫 释义 扩大生产
    • 🫧 例句 The factory is ramping upproduction for the holiday season.
    • 🌈 同义 increase production, scale up output,boost manufacturing

ramp up pressure

  • 💫 释义 施加压力, 加大压力
    • 🫧 例句 The management decided to rampup pressure on underperforming departments.
    • 🌈 同义 intensify pressure, increase pressure,escalate pressure

ramp up activities

  • 💫 释义 加强活动, 增加活动频率
    • 🫧 例句 The marketing team will ramp uppromotional activities before the product launch.
    • 🌈 同义 increase activities, intensifyoperations, step up actions

in advance

  • 💫 释义 提前, 预先
    • 🫧 例句 Please make your reservation inadvance to secure your spot.
    • 🌈 同义 beforehand, ahead of time,previously

advance payment

  • 💫 释义 预付款
    • 🫧 例句 The supplier requires anadvance payment of 30% before startingproduction.
    • 🌈 同义 upfront payment, prepayment,deposit

advance notice

  • 💫 释义 提前通知
    • 🫧 例句 The company policy requiresadvance notice of at least two weeks for vacationrequests.
    • 🌈 同义 prior notice, warning,forewarning

technological advance

  • 💫 释义 技术进步
    • 🫧 例句 Recent technologicaladvances have revolutionized the healthcare industry.
    • 🌈 同义 technological progress, technicaldevelopment, innovation

advance one’s career

  • 💫 释义 推动职业发展
    • 🫧 例句 She took additional courses toadvance her career in digital marketing.
    • 🌈 同义 promote one’s career, further one’scareer, career progression

Part 15

advance knowledge

  • 💫 释义 预先知识
    • 🫧 例句 The test requires advanceknowledge of statistical methods and data analysis.
    • 🌈 同义 prior knowledge, foreknowledge,preliminary understanding

advance ticket

  • 💫 释义 预售票
    • 🫧 例句 Advance tickets forthe concert are available online at a discounted price.
    • 🌈 同义 pre-sale ticket, early-bird ticket,reserved ticket

advance to the nextround

  • 💫 释义 晋级下一轮
    • 🫧 例句 The team performed exceptionally wellto advance to the next round of thecompetition.
    • 🌈 同义 progress to the next stage, moveforward, qualify

cash advance

  • 💫 释义 预借现金
    • 🫧 例句 The bank offers cashadvance services for credit card holders in emergencysituations.
    • 🌈 同义 loan, upfront cash, prepaidamount

advance a theory

  • 💫 释义 提出理论
    • 🫧 例句 The scientist advanced a newtheory to explain the unusual experimental results.
    • 🌈 同义 propose a theory, put forward a theory,suggest a hypothesis

advance the date

  • 💫 释义 提前日期
    • 🫧 例句 Due to unexpected circumstances, we hadto advance the date of the product launch.
    • 🌈 同义 move up the date, reschedule earlier,bring forward

high up in the hierarchy

  • 💫 释义 在等级制度中地位很高
    • 🫧 例句 She’s high up in the corporatehierarchy and makes important decisions.
    • 🌈 同义 senior position, top-level, upperechelon

high up on the list

  • 💫 释义 在列表中排名靠前
    • 🫧 例句 Finding a cure for this disease ishigh up on the list of research priorities.
    • 🌈 同义 top priority, ranking high, at theforefront

high up in the sky

  • 💫 释义 高悬空中
    • 🫧 例句 The eagle was circling high upin the sky above the mountains.
    • 🌈 同义 at a great height, soaring, elevatedposition

high up on the agenda

  • 💫 释义 议程上的重要事项
    • 🫧 例句 Climate change remains high upon the agenda for international cooperation.
    • 🌈 同义 top priority, key issue, mainfocus

Part 16

high-up ( noun )

  • 💫 释义 高层人物, 要员
    • 🫧 例句 The decision was made by thehigh-ups in the company’s headquarters.
    • 🌈 同义 senior official, top executive,higher-up

mill around

  • 💫 释义 无目的地闲逛; 成群地转悠
    • 🫧 例句 Shoppers were millingaround the mall, browsing without any specificpurpose.
    • 🌈 同义 wander aimlessly, crowd around, gatherloosely

mill about

  • 💫 释义 四处转悠; 成群移动
    • 🫧 例句 Guests were millingabout in the lobby before the conference began.
    • 🌈 同义 move around aimlessly, circulate, roamabout

mill in crowds

  • 💫 释义 在人群中穿梭
    • 🫧 例句 Protesters milled incrowds outside the government building.
    • 🌈 同义 move through crowds, throng,swarm

red flag

  • 💫 释义 危险信号, 警告标志
    • 🫧 例句 His inconsistent answers were ared flag during the job interview.
    • 🌈 同义 warning sign, danger signal, alertindicator

flag down

  • 💫 释义 挥手示意停下
    • 🫧 例句 She managed to flagdown a taxi during the heavy rain.
    • 🌈 同义 hail, signal to stop, wavedown

flag up

  • 💫 释义 标记出, 引起注意
    • 🫧 例句 The auditor flagged upseveral discrepancies in the financial report.
    • 🌈 同义 highlight, point out, draw attentionto

white flag

  • 💫 释义 白旗 ( 投降或停战标志 )
    • 🫧 例句 After hours of negotiation, theyfinally raised the white flag.
    • 🌈 同义 surrender flag, truce banner, symbol ofdefeat

flagging enthusiasm

  • 💫 释义 逐渐消退的热情
    • 🫧 例句 The team’s flaggingenthusiasm was evident after three consecutivelosses.
    • 🌈 同义 waning enthusiasm, declining interest,diminishing passion

fly the flag

  • 💫 释义 代表, 展示支持
    • 🫧 例句 Our overseas branches areflying the flag for the company in internationalmarkets.
    • 🌈 同义 represent, show support, be anambassador

Part 17

flag as inappropriate

  • 💫 释义 标记为不合适内容
    • 🫧 例句 Users can flag comments asinappropriate for moderator review.
    • 🌈 同义 report as inappropriate, mark asunsuitable, identify as problematic

be extended to

  • 💫 释义 被扩展到; 被延伸至
    • 🫧 例句 The warranty will be extendedto cover accidental damage.
    • 🌈 同义 be expanded to, be applied to, bestretched to

be extended to include

  • 💫 释义 被扩展至包括
    • 🫧 例句 The research scope will beextended to include more demographic groups.
    • 🌈 同义 be broadened to include, be enlarged toencompass

be extended to cover

  • 💫 释义 被延伸至涵盖
    • 🫧 例句 The insurance policy will beextended to cover natural disasters.
    • 🌈 同义 be expanded to cover, be stretched toinclude

be extended to apply to

  • 💫 释义 被扩展适用于
    • 🫧 例句 These regulations will beextended to apply to all subsidiary companies.
    • 🌈 同义 be broadened to apply to, be madeapplicable to

be extended toincorporate

  • 💫 释义 被扩展纳入
    • 🫧 例句 The curriculum will be extendedto incorporate digital literacy skills.
    • 🌈 同义 be expanded to include, be enhanced toincorporate

be extended to encompass

  • 💫 释义 被扩展包含
    • 🫧 例句 The project will be extended toencompass environmental sustainability.
    • 🌈 同义 be broadened to include, be expanded tocover

take care of

  • 💫 释义 照顾; 处理
    • 🫧 例句 Can you take care ofthe children while I’m away?
    • 🌈 同义 look after, attend to, handle

take part in

  • 💫 释义 参加, 参与
    • 🫧 例句 She was excited to take partin the international conference.
    • 🌈 同义 participate in, engage in, joinin

take advantage of

  • 💫 释义 利用; 占便宜
    • 🫧 例句 You should take advantageof this opportunity to learn abroad.
    • 🌈 同义 utilize, make use of, exploit

Part 18

take place

  • 💫 释义 发生, 举行
    • 🫧 例句 The wedding will takeplace in a beautiful garden.
    • 🌈 同义 happen, occur, be held

take a look at

  • 💫 释义 看一看, 检查一下
    • 🫧 例句 Could you take a lookat my computer? It’s not working properly.
    • 🌈 同义 examine, check, have a lookat

take into account

  • 💫 释义 考虑, 顾及
    • 🫧 例句 The design must take intoaccount the needs of elderly users.
    • 🌈 同义 consider, take into consideration, bearin mind

take responsibility for

  • 💫 释义 对…负责
    • 🫧 例句 A good leader must takeresponsibility for both successes and failures.
    • 🌈 同义 be accountable for, assumeresponsibility for

take a chance

  • 💫 释义 冒险一试
    • 🫧 例句 Sometimes you have to take achance to achieve great things.
    • 🌈 同义 risk it, gamble, take a risk

take notes

  • 💫 释义 记笔记
    • 🫧 例句 It’s helpful to takenotes during the lecture for later review.
    • 🌈 同义 jot down, record

take a break

  • 💫 释义 休息一下
    • 🫧 例句 Let’s take a breakafter working for two hours straight.
    • 🌈 同义 have a rest, pause, recess

take effect

  • 💫 释义 生效, 起作用
    • 🫧 例句 The new law will takeeffect from the first of next month.
    • 🌈 同义 become effective, come intoforce

take for granted

  • 💫 释义 认为…理所当然
    • 🫧 例句 We often take ourhealth for granted until we lose it.
    • 🌈 同义 assume, presume

take a seat

  • 💫 释义 请坐
    • 🫧 例句 Please take a seat andthe doctor will be with you shortly.
    • 🌈 同义 sit down, be seated

Part 19

take someone’s advice

  • 💫 释义 接受某人的建议
    • 🫧 例句 I decided to take my father’sadvice and study engineering.
    • 🌈 同义 follow someone’s advice, heed someone’scounsel

take a picture/photo

  • 💫 释义 拍照
    • 🫧 例句 May I take a pictureof this beautiful scenery?
    • 🌈 同义 photograph, snap a picture

take a step

  • 💫 释义 采取步骤
    • 🫧 例句 We need to take a stepforward in our negotiations.
    • 🌈 同义 act, move, proceed

take control of

  • 💫 释义 控制, 掌管
    • 🫧 例句 The army moved in to takecontrol of the capital city.
    • 🌈 同义 assume control of, command,manage

take a deep breath

  • 💫 释义 深呼吸
    • 🫧 例句 Take a deep breath andtry to calm down before your speech.
    • 🌈 同义 breathe deeply, inhale slowly

take a shower/bath

  • 💫 释义 淋浴/洗澡
    • 🫧 例句 I usually take ashower as soon as I get home from the gym.
    • 🌈 同义 bathe, shower

take a nap

  • 💫 释义 小睡, 打盹
    • 🫧 例句 The baby usually takes anap in the afternoon.
    • 🌈 同义 have a nap, rest, sleep for awhile

take a walk

  • 💫 释义 散步
    • 🫧 例句 Let’s take a walkafter dinner to aid our digestion.
    • 🌈 同义 go for a walk, stroll, have astroll

take a risk

  • 💫 释义 冒险
    • 🫧 例句 Starting your own business means youhave to take a risk.
    • 🌈 同义 gamble, chance it, take achance

take an interest in

  • 💫 释义 对…产生兴趣
    • 🫧 例句 He has taken an interestin learning French recently.
    • 🌈 同义 become interested in, develop interestin

Part 20

take a toll on

  • 💫 释义 对…造成损害/损失
    • 🫧 例句 The stressful job began to takea toll on his health.
    • 🌈 同义 damage, harm, affectnegatively

take the lead

  • 💫 释义 带头, 领先
    • 🫧 例句 Our company aims to take thelead in renewable energy technology.
    • 🌈 同义 lead the way, be at the forefront,pioneer

take a stand

  • 💫 释义 表明立场, 采取立场
    • 🫧 例句 It’s time to take astand against social injustice.
    • 🌈 同义 position oneself, adopt a stance, makea stand

take pride in

  • 💫 释义 为…感到自豪
    • 🫧 例句 She takes great pridein her children’s accomplishments.
    • 🌈 同义 be proud of, feel proud about

take the blame for

  • 💫 释义 承担过错
    • 🫧 例句 The CEO refused to take theblame for the company’s failure.
    • 🌈 同义 accept responsibility for, beaccountable for

take a message

  • 💫 释义 捎个口信, 带话
    • 🫧 例句 I’m afraid he’s not in. Can Itake a message ?
    • 🌈 同义 note down a message, pass on amessage

take a turn for thebetter/worse

  • 💫 释义 好转/恶化
    • 🫧 例句 The patient’s condition took aturn for the worse overnight.
    • 🌈 同义 improve/deteriorate, change for thebetter/worse

take your time

  • 💫 释义 不用急, 慢慢来
    • 🫧 例句 Take your time - wedon’t need to leave for another hour.
    • 🌈 同义 don’t rush, proceed at your ownpace

take it easy

  • 💫 释义 放松, 别紧张
    • 🫧 例句 After the exam, I’m just going totake it easy for a few days.
    • 🌈 同义 relax, unwind, calm down

take sides

  • 💫 释义 偏袒, 支持一方
    • 🫧 例句 A good mediator should nevertake sides in a dispute.
    • 🌈 同义 support one side, showpartiality

entry.title: 固定搭配-1
entry.content:
说明

  • 💫 释义 ( Meaning )
  • 🫧 例句 ( Example )
  • 🌈 同义 ( Synonym )

本文章较长，可通过 目录 或 ctrl +F 搜索.

Part 1

in connection with…

  • 💫 释义 与…相关
    • 🫧 例句 This document is in connectionwith the pending merger.

bear on… / has a bearingon…

  • 💫 释义 与…有关; 对…有影响
    • 🫧 例句 Your personal health has adirect bearing on your work performance.

on occasion

  • 💫 释义 偶尔; 有时
    • 🫧 例句 He visits the city onoccasion.

on multiple occasions

  • 💫 释义 多次; 数次
    • 🫧 例句 I’ve reminded him on multipleoccasions.

have the occasion to dosth

  • 💫 释义 有机会做某事
    • 🫧 例句 I hope you have the occasionto visit our new headquarters.

get across

  • 💫 释义 使被理解
    • 🫧 例句 It’s a difficult idea to getacross.

impress upon someone

  • 💫 释义 使某人铭记
    • 🫧 例句 I must impress uponyou the need for confidentiality.

drive home

  • 💫 释义 深刻认识
    • 🫧 例句 He used a real-life example todrive home his point.

draw…from…

  • 💫 释义 吸引; 引出
    • 🫧 例句 The speaker drewapplause from the audience. / The investigationdrew criticism from thepublic.

treat…as…

  • 💫 释义 将…视为…
    • 🫧 例句 The manager alwaystreats her employees as equals, whichfosters a positive work environment.
    • 🌈 同义 regard…as…, see…as…, view…as…, deem…(to be )…, look upon…as…, think of…as…, label…as…, perceive…as…

Part 2

turn out

  • 💫 释义 结果是/生产/出席
    • 🫧 例句 It turned out to be agreat success.

turn up

  • 💫 释义 调高/出现
    • 🫧 例句 Can you turn up thevolume? / My keys finally turned up.

turn down

  • 💫 释义 调低/拒绝
    • 🫧 例句 Please turn down themusic. / She turned down the job offer.

turn in

  • 💫 释义 上交/睡觉
    • 🫧 例句 You must turn in yourhomework. / I’m going to turn in for thenight.

turn to

  • 💫 释义 向…求助/翻到
    • 🫧 例句 He has no one to turnto. / Please turn to page 10.

turn over

  • 💫 释义 翻转/移交
    • 🫧 例句 He turned over thecard. / The thief was turned over to thepolice.

turn around

  • 💫 释义 转身/使好转
    • 🫧 例句 She turned around tosee me. / He turned the companyaround.

set up

  • 💫 释义 建立/安排/安装
    • 🫧 例句 They set up a newcompany. / I’ll set up a meeting.

set off

  • 💫 释义 触发, 启动 ( 警报、装置 )
    • 🫧 例句 The smoke set off thefire alarm.
    • 🌈 同义 activate, trigger
  • 💫 释义 引发, 导致 ( 一系列事件 )
    • 🫧 例句 His resignation setoff a chain of management changes.
    • 🌈 同义 spark, cause to begin
  • 💫 释义 出发, 启程
    • 🫧 例句 They set off on theirjourney at dawn.
    • 🌈 同义 begin a journey, start out
  • 💫 释义 衬托, 使显眼
    • 🫧 例句 The blue frame setsoff the painting perfectly.
    • 🌈 同义 enhance, make more noticeable

set out

  • 💫 释义 出发/陈述/打算
    • 🫧 例句 They set out on ajourney. / He set out his plans clearly.

Part 3

set about

  • 💫 释义 开始着手
    • 🫧 例句 She set about cleaningthe room.

set aside

  • 💫 释义 留出/搁置/驳回
    • 🫧 例句 Set aside some moneyeach month. / Let’s set aside ourdifferences.

set back

  • 💫 释义 阻碍/耽误
    • 🫧 例句 The project was setback by bad weather.

set in

  • 💫 释义 开始并持续 ( 指不好的事 )
    • 🫧 例句 Winter has setin.

set apart

  • 💫 释义 使与众不同/留出
    • 🫧 例句 Her talent sets herapart.

set on / upon

  • 💫 释义 袭击, 攻击
    • 🫧 例句 He was set upon bythieves.

set against

  • 💫 释义 使反对/以…为背景
    • 🫧 例句 The scandal set thepublic against him. / The city is beautiful setagainst the mountains.

set forth

  • 💫 释义 陈述, 阐明
    • 🫧 例句 The document setsforth the terms of the agreement.

guideline on

  • 💫 释义 关于…的指南
    • 🫧 例句 Please follow the guidelineon data security.

guideline for

  • 💫 释义 为…制定的指南
    • 🫧 例句 Here is a guidelinefor new employees.

Part 4

guideline regarding

  • 💫 释义 有关…的指导方针
    • 🫧 例句 The government issued aguideline regarding tax filing.

up to it

  • 💫 释义有能力、有精力或状态佳以应对某种挑战或完成某项任务
    • 🫧 例句 I know the project is tough, but I’msure you’re up to it.
    • 🌈 同义 capable of ( doing ) something, fit forsomething, in fit state, Equal to the task / challenge, have what ittakes, in the right state of mind ( or body )

engage in ( sth/doing sth)

  • 💫 释义 参与, 从事 ( 某项活动或工作 )
    • 🫧 例句 It’s not a topic I would engagein debate about.
    • 🌈 同义 participate in, take part in, beinvolved in

engage with sb/sth

  • 💫 释义 与…建立联系; 吸引; 致力于理解或处理
    • 🫧 例句 The company uses social media toengage with its customers.
    • 🌈 同义 connect with, interact with, involveoneself with

engage sb in sth

  • 💫 释义 使某人参与/卷入某事
    • 🫧 例句 The teacher tried to engage allthe students in the class discussion.
    • 🌈 同义 involve sb in, draw sb into, include sbin

engage sb’s interest /attention

  • 💫 释义 吸引某人的兴趣/注意力
    • 🫧 例句 The first chapter of the book isdesigned to engage the reader’s interestimmediately.
    • 🌈 同义 capture/grab one’s interest/attention,hold one’s attention, fascinate

engage sb to do sth

  • 💫 释义 雇佣/聘请某人做某事
    • 🫧 例句 We will engage a professionaldesigner to create the logo.
    • 🌈 同义 hire/employ sb to do sth, appoint sb todo sth

engage ( as sth )

  • 💫 释义 ( 以…身份 ) 聘用
    • 🫧 例句 She was engaged as aconsultant on the project.
    • 🌈 同义 hired as, employed as, appointedas

be engaged to sb

  • 💫 释义 与某人订婚
    • 🫧 例句 I’m happy to announce that my daughteris engaged to a wonderful man.
    • 🌈 同义 be betrothed to ( 非常正式 ), havepledged to marry

be engaged in sth

  • 💫 释义 正忙于, 正从事于 ( 状态 )
    • 🫧 例句 He was engaged in adeep conversation and didn’t notice me.
    • 🌈 同义 be busy with, be occupied with, beabsorbed in

Part 5

be forced into ( sth/doing sth)

  • 💫 释义 被迫 ( 接受某种状态或做某事 )
    • 🫧 例句 Many small businesses wereforced into bankruptcy during the economiccrisis.
    • 🌈 同义 be compelled to do sth, be coercedinto, be pressured into, be left with no choice but to do

come across sb/sth

  • 💫 释义 偶然遇见, 碰见
    • 🫧 例句 I came across this oldphoto while cleaning the attic.
    • 🌈 同义 run into, stumble upon, chance upon,find by chance

come across ( as sth )

  • 💫 释义 给人留下…印象; 显得
    • 🫧 例句 He comes across asvery confident in interviews.
    • 🌈 同义 seem, appear, strike someone as, givethe impression of being

come across ( with sth )

  • 💫 释义 提供 ( 所需之物, 如钱、信息 ); 交出
    • 🫧 例句 He finally came acrosswith the money he owed me.
    • 🌈 同义 provide, deliver, hand over, come upwith

come across ( sth )

  • 💫 释义 ( 想法、信息等 ) 被理解, 被传达
    • 🫧 例句 His main point didn’t comeacross clearly in the speech.
    • 🌈 同义 be understood, be communicated, getacross, be conveyed

above all else

  • 💫 释义 尤其是; 最重要的是
    • 🫧 例句 Above all else, wemust ensure the safety of our staff.
    • 🌈 同义 most importantly, first and foremost,primarily

above all

  • 💫 释义 尤其是; 最重要的是
    • 🫧 例句 He is a great leader, and aboveall, a good person.
    • 🌈 同义 most of all, more than anything else,chiefly

first and foremost

  • 💫 释义 首先; 首要的是
    • 🫧 例句 We are, first andforemost, a technology company.
    • 🌈 同义 primarily, principally, in the firstplace

most importantly

  • 💫 释义 最重要的是
    • 🫧 例句 We need to finish the project on timeand, most importantly, within budget.
    • 🌈 同义 crucially, critically, aboveall

favour A over B

  • 💫 释义 偏爱A胜过B; 更倾向于选择A而非B
    • 🫧 例句 Many investors currently favourbonds over stocks for stability.
    • 🌈 同义 prefer A to B, choose A over B, value Amore than B

Part 6

prefer A to B

  • 💫 释义 比起B来更喜欢A
    • 🫧 例句 I prefer tea to coffeein the morning.
    • 🌈 同义 favour A over B, like A better than B,would rather A than B

would rather A than B

  • 💫 释义 宁愿A也不愿B
    • 🫧 例句 I would rather stay home thango to a crowded party.
    • 🌈 同义 prefer to A rather than B, would soonerA than B

opt for A instead of B

  • 💫 释义 选择A而不是B
    • 🫧 例句 She opted for the vegetarianmenu instead of the fish dish.
    • 🌈 同义 choose A over B, go for A rather thanB, select A in place of B

give precedence to A overB

  • 💫 释义 给予A优先权胜过B ( 正式 )
    • 🫧 例句 The committee gave precedenceto environmental concerns over economic gains.
    • 🌈 同义 prioritize A above B, rank A higherthan B

not just… but also…

  • 💫 释义 不仅…而且…
    • 🫧 例句 The new policy is notjust inefficient, but also costly.
    • 🌈 同义 not only… but also…, not merely…but…

not only… but also…

  • 💫 释义 不仅…而且… ( 比 not just 稍正式 )
    • 🫧 例句 She is not only atalented writer but also an accomplishedpainter.
    • 🌈 同义 not just… but also…, not merely… but…,as well as

not merely… but…

  • 💫 释义 不仅仅…而是… ( 强调后者更重要 )
    • 🫧 例句 This is not merely asetback, but a critical failure.
    • 🌈 同义 not just… but…, not only… but…, notsimply… but…

…as well as…

  • 💫 释义 …和…; 既…又… ( 强调前者 )
    • 🫧 例句 The system is efficient as wellas user-friendly.
    • 🌈 同义 and also, in addition to, alongwith

both… and…

  • 💫 释义 两者都…; 既…又… ( 强调并列 )
    • 🫧 例句 The project requiresboth time and money.
    • 🌈 同义 and, as well as

over and above

  • 💫 释义 除…之外 ( 还 ) ( 正式 )
    • 🫧 例句 He received a bonus over andabove his regular salary.
    • 🌈 同义 in addition to, besides, on topof

Part 7

bring in sth

  • 💫 释义 赚取, 产生 ( 收入 )
    • 🫧 例句 The new product line is expected tobring in significant revenue.
    • 🌈 同义 earn, generate, yield,produce

bring in sb

  • 💫 释义 邀请…参与; 引入 ( 专家、外部力量 )
    • 🫧 例句 We need to bring in aconsultant to solve this technical issue.
    • 🌈 同义 call in, enlist, recruit,hire

bring in sth

  • 💫 释义 推行, 实施 ( 新法律、规则或系统 )
    • 🫧 例句 The government plans to bringin new regulations next year.
    • 🌈 同义 introduce, implement, institute,enact

bring in sb

  • 💫 释义 逮捕并带至警局
    • 🫧 例句 The police brought intwo suspects for questioning.
    • 🌈 同义 arrest, take into custody,apprehend

in light of

  • 💫 释义 考虑到, 鉴于
    • 🫧 例句 The meeting was rescheduled inlight of the manager’s sudden illness.
    • 🌈 同义 considering, taking into account,given, in view of

in view of

  • 💫 释义 鉴于, 考虑到
    • 🫧 例句 In view of recentdevelopments, we need to change our strategy.
    • 🌈 同义 considering, in light of, taking intoaccount, given

taking into account

  • 💫 释义 考虑到, 把…纳入考虑
    • 🫧 例句 Taking into accountall the factors, this is our best option.
    • 🌈 同义 considering, bearing in mind, in viewof, allowing for

given that

  • 💫 释义 考虑到, 鉴于 ( 后接从句 )
    • 🫧 例句 Given that the marketis volatile, we should be cautious.
    • 🌈 同义 considering that, in view of the factthat, seeing that

on account of

  • 💫 释义 由于, 因为
    • 🫧 例句 The event was postponed onaccount of bad weather.
    • 🌈 同义 because of, due to, owing to, by reasonof

owing to

  • 💫 释义 由于, 因为
    • 🫧 例句 Owing to unforeseencircumstances, the project has been delayed.
    • 🌈 同义 due to, because of, on account of, as aresult of

Part 8

in terms of

  • 💫 释义 在…方面; 从…角度来说
    • 🫧 例句 The project is successful interms of its final outcome.
    • 🌈 同义 with regard to, regarding, from theperspective of, as regards, in the aspect of

come to terms with

  • 💫 释义 接受 ( 困难或不愉快的现实 ); 与…达成妥协
    • 🫧 例句 It took him years to come toterms with his loss.
    • 🌈 同义 accept, reconcile oneself to, learn tolive with, make peace with

in the long/short term

  • 💫 释义 从长/短期来看
    • 🫧 例句 This decision will benefit the companyin the long term.
    • 🌈 同义 over the long/short haul, from along/short-term perspective

on good/bad terms ( with )

  • 💫 释义 ( 与某人 ) 关系好/不好
    • 🫧 例句 She is on good termswith all her colleagues.
    • 🌈 同义 have a good/bad relationship with, befriendly with/be at odds with

a term of art

  • 💫 释义 专业术语; 特定领域内的专门用语
    • 🫧 例句 “Liquidated damages” is a termof art in contract law.
    • 🌈 同义 technical term, specializedterminology, jargon

be on speaking terms

  • 💫 释义 关系尚可 ( 至少能交谈 )
    • 🫧 例句 They are not friends, but they areon speaking terms.
    • 🌈 同义 be civil to each other, maintaincordial relations

argument for

  • 💫 释义 支持…的论点
    • 🫧 例句 One strong argumentfor remote work is increased productivity.
    • 🌈 同义 case for, reason for, justificationfor

make a case for

  • 💫 释义 提出理由支持
    • 🫧 例句 The report makes a compellingcase for increased funding.
    • 🌈 同义 argue for, advocate for, presentarguments for

in favor of

  • 💫 释义 支持, 赞成
    • 🫧 例句 The committee voted in favorof the proposal.
    • 🌈 同义 supportive of, for, approvingof

justification for

  • 💫 释义 …的理由/依据
    • 🫧 例句 There’s no justificationfor such rude behavior.
    • 🌈 同义 reason for, grounds for, basisfor

Part 9

reason for

  • 💫 释义 …的原因/理由
    • 🫧 例句 What was the reasonfor your decision?
    • 🌈 同义 cause of, basis for, groundsfor

defense of

  • 💫 释义 为…辩护
    • 🫧 例句 She spoke in defenseof the new policy.
    • 🌈 同义 justification of, support for, advocacyfor

argue sb into doing sth

  • 💫 释义 说服某人做某事
    • 🫧 例句 She tried to argue him intoaccepting the job offer.
    • 🌈 同义 persuade sb to do sth, talk sb intodoing sth, convince sb to do sth

argue sb out of doingsth

  • 💫 释义 说服某人不做某事
    • 🫧 例句 I managed to argue him out ofquitting his job.
    • 🌈 同义 dissuade sb from doing sth, talk sb outof doing sth, discourage sb from doing sth

persuade sb to do sth

  • 💫 释义 说服某人做某事
    • 🫧 例句 We need to persuade them toinvest in our project.
    • 🌈 同义 convince sb to do sth, talk sb intodoing sth, coax sb into doing sth

talk sb into doing sth

  • 💫 释义 说服某人做某事
    • 🫧 例句 He talked me into going to theparty with him.
    • 🌈 同义 persuade sb to do sth, convince sb todo sth, win sb over to doing sth

talk sb out of doing sth

  • 💫 释义 说服某人不做某事
    • 🫧 例句 I tried to talk her out ofmaking such a risky investment.
    • 🌈 同义 dissuade sb from doing sth, discouragesb from doing sth, advise sb against doing sth

More often than not

  • 💫 释义 通常; 多半
    • 🫧 例句 More often than not, he takes the busto work.
    • 🌈 同义 usually, generally, as often as not,more than half the time

push for

  • 💫 释义 争取, 敦促
    • 🫧 例句 The team is pushingfor a quick decision on the matter.
    • 🌈 同义 advocate for, campaign for, pressfor

push through

  • 💫 释义 强行通过, 努力完成
    • 🫧 例句 The government pushedthrough the new law despite opposition.
    • 🌈 同义 force through, ram through, carryout

Part 10

push back ( against )

  • 💫 释义 抵制, 反对
    • 🫧 例句 The public pushed backagainst the proposed tax increase.
    • 🌈 同义 resist, oppose, fight backagainst

push forward

  • 💫 释义 推进, 继续前进
    • 🫧 例句 We must push forwardwith the plan despite the difficulties.
    • 🌈 同义 advance, proceed, move ahead

push aside

  • 💫 释义 推开; 忽视
    • 🫧 例句 She pushed aside herdoubts and accepted the challenge.
    • 🌈 同义 disregard, ignore, set aside

push sb to do sth

  • 💫 释义 督促/逼迫某人做某事
    • 🫧 例句 His parents pushed him to applyto top universities.
    • 🌈 同义 urge sb to do sth, pressure sb to dosth, compel sb to do sth

get ahead of

  • 💫 释义 领先于; 超越; 提前处理
    • 🫧 例句 We need to innovate constantly toget ahead of our competitors.
    • 🌈 同义 overtake, outpace, surpass, stay aheadof

get ahead of oneself

  • 💫 释义 操之过急; 过早行动 ( 常指因兴奋而考虑不周 )
    • 🫧 例句 Let’s not get ahead ofourselves —we haven’t even won the contract yet.
    • 🌈 同义 jump the gun, act prematurely, beoverhasty

stay ahead of

  • 💫 释义 保持领先于
    • 🫧 例句 It’s hard to stay aheadof the latest technological trends.
    • 🌈 同义 maintain a lead over, keep an advantageover, outrun

keep ahead of

  • 💫 释义 保持领先于; 抢先一步
    • 🫧 例句 We read industry reports tokeep ahead of market changes.
    • 🌈 同义 stay ahead of, anticipate,preempt

ahead of the curve

  • 💫 释义 领先于潮流 ( 或趋势 )
    • 🫧 例句 Their investment in renewable energyput them ahead of the curve.
    • 🌈 同义 trendsetting, pioneering, innovative,cutting-edge

address an issue

  • 💫 释义 处理问题
    • 🫧 例句 The management held a meeting toaddress the safety issues.
    • 🌈 同义 deal with a problem, handle a matter,tackle an issue

entry.title: 主语从句全类型写作应用指南
entry.content:
主语从句全类型写作应用指南

主语从句是充当句子 “主语”的从句，能将复杂信息整合为句子核心，让表达更严谨、有深度，适用于议论文、说明文、正式书信等需要传递观点或事实的体裁.以下按 “类型 + 引导词 + 场景 + 例句 + 技巧” 的结构，完整梳理 6大核心主语从句.

  mindmap  root((主语从句))    陈述事实/观点 ( that )      句首 That + 从句      形式主语 It + be + ... + that    不确定/疑问 ( whether/if )      句首 Whether ( 不可用 if )      形式主语 It + be + ... + whether/if    强调人/事/物 ( 连接代词 )      What ( 什么 / 所 ... 的事物 )      Who/Whom ( 谁 )      Which ( 哪一个 )    强调时/地/因/果 ( 连接副词 )      When ( 何时 )      Where ( 何地 )      Why ( 为何 )      How ( 如何 )    任意性强调 ( 疑问词 + ever )      Whatever / Whoever      Whenever / Wherever    形式主语 It      It + be + 名词/形容词      It + be + done      It + vi. ( happens/seems )

that 引导的主语从句陈述 “确定的事实或观点”

核心特点与引导词

  • 引导词 that (无实际含义，仅起连接作用，不可省略，尤其在句首时 )

  • 核心作用用于陈述客观事实、明确观点或表达主观判断，从句内容是确定的信息.

  • 常见结构

    1. That + 从句 + 谓语 ( 直接位于句首作主语 )
    2. It + be + 名词/形容词/过去分词 + that 从句 ( 用 it作形式主语，避免句子头重脚轻 )

写作场景 & 例句 ( 覆盖不同体裁)

议论文 ( 提出观点 ) 明确核心论点，增强说服力

  • That environmental protection is everyone’s responsibility hasbecome a common consensus. (环境保护是每个人的责任，这已成为普遍共识 —— 直接用 that从句作主语，观点鲜明. )
  • It is a well-known fact that deforestation leads to globalwarming. ( 众所周知，森林砍伐会导致全球变暖 —— 用 it作形式主语，句式更均衡. )

说明文 ( 陈述事实 ) 传递客观信息，体现准确性

  • That the earth revolves around the sun was proved byCopernicus. ( 地球绕太阳转，这一观点由哥白尼提出 —— 陈述科学事实.)
  • It is important that we save water in daily life. (在日常生活中节约用水很重要 —— 强调事实的重要性. )

正式书信 ( 表达看法 ) 传递严谨的态度

  • It is my sincere hope that we can cooperate on thisproject. ( 我真诚希望我们能在这个项目上合作 ——表达主观期望，语气正式. )

避坑技巧

  • that 不可省略 即使从句位于句末 ( 用 it 作形式主语时)，that 也不能省.
    • ✗ It is true we need to workhard.
    • √ It is truethat we need to work hard.
  • 主谓一致 主语从句视为“单数”，谓语动词用第三人称单数.
    • That she studies hard helps her get goodgrades. ( helps 不用 help )

whether/if引导的主语从句 表达 “不确定的选择或疑问”

核心特点与引导词

  • 引导词 whether ( 可用于句首或句中，表“是否”，涵盖两种可能性 ); if ( 仅能用于 “it 作形式主语”的句中，不可用于句首 )

  • 核心作用用于表达不确定的情况、选择或委婉的疑问，从句内容是“有待确认的信息”.

  • 常见结构

    1. Whether + 从句 + 谓语 ( 句首作主语，不可用 if 替换)
    2. It + be + 形容词/名词 + whether/if 从句 ( it作形式主语，句中可用 if )

写作场景 & 例句

议论文 ( 分析可能性 )讨论不确定的观点，体现辩证思维

  • Whether online education can replace traditional classrooms isstill under debate. ( 在线教育是否能取代传统课堂，仍在争论中 ——句首用 whether，不可换 if. )
  • It is uncertain if we can finish the task on time. (我们是否能按时完成任务，还不确定 ——it 作形式主语，句中用 if. )

说明文 ( 提出疑问 ) 引发思考，传递客观态度

  • Whether plants can grow without sunlight is a question manychildren ask. ( 植物没有阳光是否能生长，是很多孩子会问的问题 ——句首用 whether，表疑问. )
  • It is a key issue whether the new policy will be carried outnext year. ( 新政策明年是否会实施，是关键问题 —— 强调疑问的重要性.)

书信 ( 委婉询问 ) 语气礼貌，避免生硬

  • It is unclear whether you will attend the meeting tomorrow.( 不清楚你明天是否会参加会议 —— 用 whether 表委婉询问. )

避坑技巧

  • 句首必用 whether 主语从句位于句首时，只能用whether，不能用 if.
    • ✗ If he will come isunknown.
    • √ Whether he will come isunknown.
  • 与 or not 搭配 whether 可直接接 or not，if 需分开用“if…or not”.
    • Whether we go or not depends on the weather.
    • It is unknown if we go or not.
连接代词引导的主语从句强调 “具体的人、事、物或方式”

引导词分类 ( 按指代内容 )

连接代词功能表

引导词具体含义核心作用
what“… 的事物 / 内容”指代事物、信息或内容
who“谁”指代人 ( 主格，作从句主语 )
whom“谁”指代人 ( 宾格，作从句宾语 )
whose“谁的”指代所属关系
which“哪一个 / 哪一些”指代特定范围内的选择

写作场景 & 例句

议论文 ( 聚焦核心 ) 明确讨论的对象，让观点更聚焦

  • What we need most now is teamwork. (我们现在最需要的是团队合作 ——what 指代 “需要的事物”，突出核心需求.)
  • Who will be in charge of the project has not been decidedyet. ( 谁来负责这个项目，还没决定 ——who 指代人，明确讨论的主体.)

说明文 ( 解释细节 ) 补充具体信息，让内容更清晰

  • Whose idea it was to hold the party is not important now. (举办派对是谁的主意，现在已不重要 ——whose 表所属，说明信息归属. )
  • Which method is more effective will be tested in theexperiment. ( 哪种方法更有效，将在实验中验证 ——which表选择，限定范围. )

记叙文 ( 描述场景 )突出关键人物或事物，增强画面感

  • What he said at the meeting moved everyone present. (他在会上说的话，打动了在场的每个人 ——what 指代 “说的内容”，强调关键信息.)

避坑技巧

  • what vs. that what 在从句中需充当成分 (主语、宾语等 ) ，that 不充当成分.
    • √ What he did was right.( what 作 did 的宾语. )
    • √ That he did it isright. ( that 不充当成分. )
  • who vs. whom who 在从句中作主语，whom 作宾语.
    • √ Who will go with us isunclear. ( who 作从句主语. )
    • √ Whom we should ask for helpis a problem. ( whom 作 ask 的宾语. )
连接副词引导的主语从句强调 “时间、地点、原因或方式”

引导词分类 ( 按逻辑关系 )

连接副词功能表

引导词具体含义核心作用
when“何时”指代时间
where“何地”指代地点
why“为什么”指代原因
how“如何”指代方式、方法或程度

写作场景 & 例句

议论文 ( 分析逻辑 )明确时间、原因等逻辑，让论证更严谨

  • When we should start the project needs further discussion.( 我们应该何时启动项目，需要进一步讨论 ——when指代时间，明确讨论的时间维度. )
  • Why he refused the offer is still a mystery. (他为什么拒绝这个 offer，仍是个谜 ——why 指代原因，引发对原因的思考.)

说明文 ( 解释流程 )说明方式、地点等细节，让步骤更清晰

  • How we can solve this problem is explained in the report. (我们如何解决这个问题，在报告中有说明 ——how 指代方式，指导解决方法.)
  • Where the new library will be built has been announced. (新图书馆将建在何处，已公布 ——where 指代地点，明确位置信息. )

书信 ( 说明计划 )传递时间、方式等信息，让计划更具体

  • When I will visit you next month depends on my workschedule. ( 我下个月何时去看你，取决于我的工作安排 ——when指代时间，说明计划的不确定性. )

避坑技巧

  • 不可省略引导词 连接副词在从句中作状语 (时间、地点等 ) ，不可省略.
    • ✗ We will meet is notdecided.
    • √ When we will meet is notdecided.
  • 从句用陈述语序无论引导词是疑问词还是其他，主语从句都用 “主语 + 谓语” 的陈述语序.
    • ✗ How can we do it is aquestion.
    • √ How we can do it is aquestion.

“疑问词 + ever”引导的主语从句 表达 “任意性或强调”

引导词分类 ( 按指代范围 )

“疑问词+ever” 功能表

引导词具体含义核心作用
whatever“无论什么”指代事物，强调 “任意事物”
whoever“无论谁”指代人，强调 “任何人”
whichever“无论哪一个”指代选择，强调 “任意选择”
whenever“无论何时”指代时间，强调 “任意时间”
wherever“无论何地”指代地点，强调 “任意地点”
however“无论如何 / 多么”指代方式或程度，强调 “任意方式 /程度”

写作场景 & 例句

议论文 ( 强调普遍性 )突出观点的适用范围，增强说服力

  • Whatever we do, we should stick to our principles. (无论我们做什么，都应坚守原则 ——whatever 强调“任意事情”，体现观点的普遍性. )
  • Whoever breaks the rules should be punished. (无论谁违反规则，都应受到惩罚 ——whoever 强调 “任何人”，突出规则的公平性.)

说明文 ( 强调灵活性 )说明方式、时间等的灵活性，让内容更全面

  • Whenever you have questions, you can call me. (无论你何时有问题，都可以打电话给我 ——whenever 强调“任意时间”，体现便利性. )
  • However you choose to solve the problem, make sure it’ssafe. ( 无论你选择如何解决这个问题，都要确保安全 ——however 强调“任意方式”，给出灵活建议. )

正式演讲 ( 增强气势 ) 用强调语气传递坚定态度

  • Whatever difficulties we face, we will never give up. (无论我们面临什么困难，都绝不会放弃 ——whatever 增强语气，体现决心. )

避坑技巧

  • 区分 “疑问词 + ever” 与 “no matter + 疑问词”前者可引导主语从句，后者仅能引导让步状语从句.
    • ✗ No matter what you say isright.
    • √ Whatever you say isright.
  • however 的用法 however 表 “无论多么” 时，后接形容词/ 副词.
    • √ However difficult it is, wewill try. ( difficult 是形容词，位于 however 后.)

“it 作形式主语”的主语从句 避免 “头重脚轻”

核心特点与常见结构

  • 核心作用 当主语从句较长时，用 it作形式主语，将真正的主语从句放在句末，使句子结构更均衡，避免头重脚轻.

  • 常见结构 ( 按表语类型分类 )

    1. It + be + 名词 ( a fact, a pity, a problem… ) +that 从句
    2. It + be + 形容词 ( true, important, necessary… ) +that 从句
    3. It + be + 过去分词 ( said, believed, reported… ) +that 从句
    4. It + 不及物动词 ( happens, seems, appears… ) + that从句

写作场景 & 例句

议论文 ( 优化句式 )让论点表达更流畅，避免句式生硬

  • It is a great pity that many historical buildings weredestroyed. ( 很遗憾，许多历史建筑被毁坏了 —— 用 it 作形式主语，避免“that many historical buildings…is a pity” 的头重脚轻结构. )
  • It is believed that hard work leads to success. (人们认为，努力工作能带来成功 —— 用被动语态 + it 作形式主语，语气更客观.)

说明文 ( 传递信息 ) 让客观事实的表达更自然

  • It happens that I know the person you mentioned. (碰巧我认识你提到的那个人 ——it happens that 结构，传递偶然的事实. )
  • It is necessary that we learn to use new technology. (我们有必要学会使用新技术 ——it is necessary that 结构，强调必要性. )

新闻报道 ( 增强正式感 ) 用客观句式传递信息

  • It has been reported that the number of endangered animals isincreasing. ( 据报道，濒危动物的数量正在增加 ——it has been reportedthat 结构，符合新闻的正式语气. )

避坑技巧

  • it 不可省略 形式主语 it 仅起占位作用，不能省略.
    • ✗ Is important that we practiceEnglish.
    • √ It is important that wepractice English.
  • 从句的虚拟语气 在 it isnecessary/important/suggested… 等结构中，that 从句常用 “should +动词原形” ( should 可省略 ).
    • √ It is suggested that we (should ) hold a meeting. ( suggested 后从句用虚拟语气.)

总结 写作中主语从句的 “3 个核心用法原则”

  1. 先定内容确定性，再选引导词 若内容是确定的事实 /观点，用 that; 若不确定 ( 是否 / 选择 ) ，用 whether/if; 若需指代人 / 事/ 时间等，用连接代词 / 副词或 “疑问词 + ever”.
  2. 巧用形式主语 it，优化句式 当主语从句较长 ( 超过 10个词 ) 时，优先用 “it + be + … + that 从句”结构，避免句子头重脚轻，提升阅读体验.
  3. 坚守陈述语序，避免语法错误 无论引导词是疑问词 (what, when 等 ) 还是其他，主语从句都必须用 “主语 + 谓语”的陈述语序，不能用疑问句语序.

entry.title: 状语从句全类型写作应用指南
entry.content:
状语从句全类型写作应用指南

状语从句是写作中 “连接逻辑、升级表达”的关键工具，能将简单句转化为有层次的复合句，适用于记叙文、议论文、书信、说明文等所有体裁.以下按 “类型 + 引导词 + 场景 + 例句 + 技巧” 的结构，完整梳理 9大核心状语从句.

时间状语从句：描述“动作发生的时间关系”

引导词分类 ( 按时间逻辑 )　

引导词类型具体词汇核心作用
同时发生when, while, as两个动作同步进行
先后发生 ( 前→后 )　after, since先发生 A，再发生 B; 从 A 开始到现在
先后发生 ( 后→前 )　before, until/till先发生 B，再发生 A; 直到 A 才停止 B
一…就…as soon as, the moment动作 A 发生后，B 立即发生

写作场景 & 例句 ( 覆盖不同体裁)　

  • 记叙文 ( 讲故事 )　：描述事件发展顺序

    While my mom was cooking in the kitchen, I was doing my mathhomework. ( 妈妈在厨房做饭时，我正在做数学作业 —— 同步动作 )　

    As soon as I heard the bell, I rushed out of the classroom. (一听到铃声，我就冲出了教室 —— 即时动作 )　

  • 议论文 ( 论证观点 )　：说明时间与观点的关联

    Since we started using online tools for study, our learningefficiency has improved a lot. (自从我们开始用在线工具学习，效率提升了很多 —— 从过去到现在的持续影响)　

  • 说明文 ( 讲流程 )　：解释步骤的先后

    Wash your hands carefully before you eat anything. (吃东西前要仔细洗手 —— 先做 A 再做 B )　

避坑技巧

  • while 后接 “延续性动作” ( 如 cooking, reading )　，when 可接“瞬间动作” ( 如 heard, saw )　;

  • until 用于肯定句时，主句动词是 “延续性动作” ( 如 wait, stay)　，例：I waited until he came back.

条件状语从句：表达“假设、前提或条件”

引导词分类 ( 按条件强度 )　

引导词类型具体词汇核心作用
真实条件 ( 可能实现 )　if, as long as, so long as假设的条件有实现的可能
否定条件unless ( =if not )　“如果不…就…”，反向条件
让步条件 ( 无论… )　no matter what, whatever不管条件如何，结果都不变

写作场景 & 例句

  • 议论文 ( 提建议 )　：给出实现观点的条件

    As long as we keep trying, we will finally achieve our goals. (只要我们坚持努力，终会实现目标 —— 正面条件 )　

    Unless we protect the environment, more animals will disappear. (如果我们不保护环境，更多动物会消失 —— 否定条件 )　

  • 书信 ( 提计划 )　：说明计划的前提

    If I have time this weekend, I will visit you. (如果这周末有空，我就去看你 —— 真实条件 )　

  • 说明文 ( 讲规则 )　：明确规则的适用条件

    No matter what the weather is like, we have to go to school onweekdays. ( 无论天气如何，工作日我们都要上学 —— 让步条件 )　

避坑技巧

  • 真实条件句中，“从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时” ( 简称“主将从现” )　，不能说 “If it will rain…”，正确：If it rains…;

  • unless 本身含否定，后面不接 not，不能说 “Unless you don’tstudy…”.

原因状语从句：解释“观点或行为的原因”

引导词分类 ( 按原因的 “明显程度”)　

引导词类型具体词汇核心作用
直接原因 ( 强调 )　because回答 “why”，原因较重要
间接原因 ( 已知 )　since, as原因显而易见，相当于 “既然”
补充原因now that“既然已经…，那接下来…”

写作场景 & 例句

  • 议论文 ( 论证观点 )　：解释观点的依据

    Online shopping is popular because it is convenient and cheap. (网购受欢迎，因为它方便又便宜 —— 直接原因，回答 “为什么受欢迎” )　

    Since everyone has different ideas, we need to discuss more. (既然每个人想法不同，我们需要多讨论 —— 间接原因，原因已知 )　

  • 记叙文 ( 写感受 )　：说明情绪的原因

    I was very happy as I got a good grade in the exam. (我很开心，因为考试考了好成绩 —— 间接原因，原因较明显 )　

  • 书信 ( 道歉 / 解释 )　：补充说明情况

    Now that you know the truth, I hope you can forgive me. (既然你已经知道真相，希望你能原谅我 —— 补充原因，强调 “已经发生的前提”)　

避坑技巧

  • because 不能和 so 同时用 ( 中文 “因为…所以…”，英文只能选一个)　，错误：Because it’s late, so I have to go. 正确：Because it’s late,I have to go.

  • since/as 引导的从句常放在句首，because从句可放句首或句末.

让步状语从句：表达 “转折 +让步” ( “虽然…但是…” )　

引导词分类 ( 按让步的 “角度” )　

引导词类型具体词汇核心作用
常规让步though, although“虽然…，但是…” ( 主句不用 but )　
极端让步even if, even though“即使…，也…” ( 假设更极端的情况 )　
特殊让步 ( 无论… )　no matter how/what/when“无论…，都…” ( 覆盖所有情况 )　

写作场景 & 例句

  • 议论文 ( 辩证观点 )　：让观点更全面，不绝对

    Although this method is simple, it is not suitable for everyone. (虽然这个方法简单，但并不适合所有人 —— 常规让步，平衡观点 )　

    Even if we fail many times, we should not give up. (即使失败很多次，我们也不该放弃 —— 极端让步，强调坚持 )　

  • 记叙文 ( 写经历 )　：突出 “克服困难” 的过程

    No matter how tired I was, I kept running to the finish line. (无论我多累，都坚持跑到了终点 —— 特殊让步，强调 “所有情况都不放弃”)　

避坑技巧

  • though/although 和 but 不能同时用，正确：Though it’s hard, I willtry. ( 不能加 but )　;

  • no matter how 后接 “形容词 / 副词”，no matter what 后接“名词”，例：No matter how hard it is / No matter what difficulties weface.

目的状语从句：说明“做某事的目的”

引导词分类 ( 按 “正式程度” )　

引导词类型具体词汇核心作用适用场景
常用 ( 非正式 )　so that“为了…，以便…”口语、记叙文、书信
正式in order that同 so that，更正式议论文、说明文、正式书信

写作场景 & 例句

  • 记叙文 ( 写行动 )　：说明动作的目的

    I took a notebook with me so that I could write down importantthings. ( 我带了笔记本，以便记下重要的事 —— 日常场景，非正式)　

  • 议论文 ( 提措施 )　：说明措施的目的

    We should plant more trees in order that we can improve the airquality. ( 我们应该多植树，为了改善空气质量 —— 正式观点，用 in orderthat )　

  • 说明文 ( 讲方法 )　：解释方法的作用

    You need to read the instructions carefully so that you won’t makemistakes. ( 你要仔细读说明书，以免出错 —— 说明目的，避免负面结果)　

避坑技巧

  • 从句中常接 “can/could/will/would” 等情态动词，表“能够、会”;

  • so that 表 “目的” 时，不能和 “so ( 所以 )　” 混淆，例：He studiedhard so that he could pass ( 目的 )　; He studied hard, so he passed (结果 )　.

结果状语从句：表达“动作带来的结果”

引导词分类 ( 按 “结果的程度” )　

引导词类型具体词汇核心作用结构特点
常规结果so…that…“如此…以至于…”so + 形容词 / 副词 + that 从句
强调结果 ( 正式 )　such…that…同 so…that…，更强调名词such+ ( a/an )　+ 名词 + that 从句

写作场景 & 例句

  • 记叙文 ( 写感受 )　：强调结果的程度

    The movie was so touching that I cried. ( 电影如此感人，以至于我哭了——so + 形容词 touching )　

    She spoke so fast that no one could follow her. (她说话太快，没人能跟上 ——so + 副词 fast )　

  • 议论文 ( 强调影响 )　：突出观点的结果

    It was such a useful book that I read it twice. (这是一本如此有用的书，我读了两遍 ——such+a + 名词 book )　

    There are such many people in the park that we can’t find a seat. (公园里人太多，我们找不到座位 ——such+many + 名词 people )　

避坑技巧

  • 区分 so 和 such：so 后接 “adj./adv.”，such 后接 “名词”，不能说“so a good book”，正确：such a good book 或 so good a book;

  • 从句是 “自然结果”，前面不用逗号 ( so…that 中间无逗号 )　，例：Heis so tall that he can reach the shelf.

比较状语从句：表达“两者的比较关系”

引导词分类 ( 按 “比较类型” )　

引导词类型具体词汇核心作用结构
同级比较 ( 和…一样 )　as…as…“A 和 B 一样…”肯定：as+adj./adv.+as; 否定：not as/so+adj./adv.+as
比较级 ( 比…更 )　than“A 比 B 更…”形容词 / 副词比较级 + than 从句
最高级 ( 最… )　the…the…“越…，越…”the + 比较级，the + 比较级

写作场景 & 例句

  • 议论文 ( 对比观点 )　：比较不同事物的优劣

    Studying at home is as convenient as studying at school. (在家学习和在学校学习一样方便 —— 同级肯定 )　

    This new phone is more expensive than the old one. (这部新手机比旧的贵 —— 比较级 )　

  • 说明文 ( 讲特点 )　：描述事物的比较关系

    The more you practice, the better you will be at English. (你练习得越多，英语就越好 ——the…the… )　

  • 书信 ( 提感受 )　：表达个人感受的比较

    I think this restaurant is not so delicious as the one we went tolast time. ( 我觉得这家餐厅不如上次去的那家好吃 —— 同级否定 )　

避坑技巧

  • than 从句中常省略 “与主句重复的部分”，例：He runs faster than I(run). ( 省略 run )　;

  • the…the… 结构中，前后都要用 “比较级”，不能说 “The more you read,the good you write.” ( good→better )　.

方式状语从句：表达“动作的方式”

常用引导词

as ( 像…一样 )　、as if/as though ( 好像…似的 )　

写作场景 & 例句

  • 记叙文 ( 描述动作 )　：说明做事的方式

    She sings as her mother did when she was young. (她唱歌的样子，就像她妈妈年轻时一样 ——as 引导，真实方式 )　

    He looked at me as if he didn’t know me. ( 他看着我，好像不认识我一样——as if 引导，假设的方式 )　

  • 说明文 ( 讲方法 )　：解释做某事的步骤

    You should do the experiment as the teacher told you. (你要按照老师说的方法做实验 ——as 引导，具体方式 )　

避坑技巧

  • as if/as though 引导的从句，若表示 “非真实的假设”，常用“虚拟语气”，例：She talks as if she were a doctor. ( 她说话像个医生似的—— 实际不是，用 were )　;

  • 不能用 “like” 引导从句 ( like 是介词，后接名词 / 代词)　，错误：Do it like I told you. 正确：Do it as I told you.

地点状语从句：表达“动作发生的地点”

常用引导词

where ( 在…的地方 )　、wherever ( 无论在…的地方 )　

写作场景 & 例句

  • 记叙文 ( 描述地点 )　：说明事件发生的位置

    We should stay where it is safe during the earthquake. (地震时，我们要待在安全的地方 ——where 引导，具体地点 )　

    Wherever he goes, he always takes a book with him. (无论他去哪里，总带着一本书 ——wherever 引导，任意地点 )　

  • 议论文 ( 提观点 )　：强调地点的普遍性

    We should protect the environment wherever we live. (无论我们住在哪里，都要保护环境 ——wherever 引导，覆盖所有情况)　

避坑技巧

  • 地点状语从句不能用 “介词 + which” 代替 ( 定语从句可以)　，例：This is the place where I was born. ( where引导地点状语从句，不能说 in which )　;

  • wherever=“no matter where”，表 “无论哪里”，语气比 where更强.

总结：写作中状语从句的 “3个核心用法原则”

先定逻辑，再选引导词：先明确句子间是“时间、条件、原因” 等哪种逻辑，再对应选引导词 ( 如 “原因” 选because/since，“让步” 选 though/even if )　;

简化重复，保持简洁：从句中与主句重复的主语、谓语可省略( 如 He is taller than I (am) )　，避免啰嗦;

根据体裁选正式度：非正式场景 ( 记叙文、书信 )　用 sothat, when; 正式场景 ( 议论文、说明文 )　用 in order that, although.

entry.title: 常见的逻辑关系词
entry.content:
逻辑关系词，也称为“语篇标记语”，像路标一样，指引读者理解句子之间和段落之间的逻辑流向.

核心逻辑关系分类

我们将逻辑关系分为八大类，每一类都有其特定的功能和常用词汇.

因果关系

表示一个事件或情况是另一个事件或情况的原因或结果.

  • 常用词汇：
    • 连词： because, since, as, for, so, therefore,hence, thus
    • 介词/短语： because of, due to, owing to, as aresult of, on account of
    • 副词/过渡词： consequently, as a consequence,accordingly
  • 例句与辨析：
    • Because/Since/As it was raining, we canceled thepicnic. ( 因为下雨，我们取消了野餐. )
      • Because 语气最强，直接回答 “为什么”;Since 和 As常用于已知的原因，语气稍弱.
    • The company is expanding. Therefore/Thus/Hence, weare hiring new staff. ( 公司正在扩张. 因此，我们正在招聘新员工. )
      • Therefore 最常用; Thus 和Hence 更正式，Hence后面有时可直接跟名词.
    • The flight was delayed due to bad weather. (航班因恶劣天气而延误. )
      • Due to 通常用于引导原因，后接名词或名词短语.
    • He worked hard, and as a result, he was promoted.(他工作努力，结果得到了晋升. )

转折/对比关系

表示与前述内容相反或形成对比的观点.

  • 常用词汇：
    • 连词： but, yet, while, whereas
    • 副词/过渡词： however, nevertheless, nonetheless,on the contrary, in contrast, on the other hand, conversely
  • 例句与辨析：
    • I wanted to go, but I was too tired. (我想去，但我太累了. )
      • But 是最常用的口语化转折词.
    • She is very outgoing, while/whereas her brother isquite shy. ( 她非常外向，而她哥哥则相当害羞. )
      • While 和 Whereas用于比较两个事物的鲜明对比.
    • The plan has some risks. However, we believe it’sworth trying. ( 这个计划有些风险. 然而，我们认为值得一试. )
      • However 是书面语中最常用的转折词，语气比but 正式.
    • It was raining heavily. Nevertheless, they decidedto go ahead with the match. ( 雨下得很大.尽管如此，他们还是决定继续比赛. )
      • Nevertheless 和 Nonetheless 表示“尽管有前述情况，但还是…”.

递进/并列关系

表示添加类似或补充的信息.

  • 常用词汇：
    • 连词： and, both…and…, not only…but also…
    • 副词/过渡词： furthermore, moreover, in addition,besides, additionally, likewise, similarly
  • 例句与辨析：
    • She is intelligent and hardworking. (她既聪明又勤奋. )
    • The product is affordable. Furthermore/Moreover,it’s very high quality. ( 这个产品价格实惠. 此外，它的质量很高. )
      • Furthermore 和 Moreover几乎同义，用于添加更重要的论据.
    • You need a passport to travel abroad. Besides, youmight need a visa. ( 出国旅行需要护照. 此外，你可能还需要签证. )
      • Besides常用来引入一个额外的、有时是更强的理由.
    • Not only did he finish first, but healso broke the record. ( 他不仅第一个完成，还打破了纪录. )

条件关系

表示一个情况依赖于另一个情况.

  • 常用词汇：
    • 连词： if, unless, provided that, providing that,as long as, in case
    • 其他： otherwise, or else
  • 例句与辨析：
    • If it rains, we will stay indoors. (如果下雨，我们就待在室内. )
    • You cannot enter unless you have a ticket. (除非你有票，否则不能进入. )
      • Unless = if not.
    • You can borrow my car as long as you drivecarefully. ( 只要你小心驾驶，就可以借我的车. )
    • Take an umbrella in case it rains. (带把伞，以防下雨. )
    • We must hurry; otherwise, we will be late. (我们必须快点，否则会迟到. )

举例与阐释关系

用于引入例子或更详细的解释.

  • 常用词汇：
    • 过渡词： for example, for instance, such as, like,namely, that is to say, in other words
  • 例句与辨析：
    • I love tropical fruits, for example/for instance,mangoes and pineapples. ( 我喜欢热带水果，例如芒果和菠萝. )
    • Many countries, such as France and Italy, are inEurope. ( 许多国家，比如法国和意大利，都在欧洲. )
      • Such as 和 like 后直接跟例子.
    • He explained the concept, in other words, he madeit easier to understand. ( 他解释了这个概念，换句话说，他让它更容易理解.)
    • There is one thing I need: namely, your support. (有一件事我需要：即你的支持. )

时间与顺序关系

表示事件发生的先后顺序或时间段.

  • 常用词汇：
    • 连词/介词： when, while, as, before, after, since,until
    • 副词/过渡词： first, firstly, second, secondly,then, next, subsequently, meanwhile, simultaneously, finally,eventually
  • 例句与辨析：
    • When I arrived, the meeting had already started. (当我到达时，会议已经开始了. )
    • While I was cooking, he was setting the table. (我在做饭的时候，他在摆餐具. )
      • While 强调两个动作同时持续进行.
    • First, preheat the oven. Then, mixthe ingredients. Finally, bake for 30 minutes. (首先，预热烤箱. 然后，混合原料. 最后，烘烤30分钟. )
    • She was studying in the library. Meanwhile, herfriends were at the cinema. ( 她在图书馆学习.与此同时，她的朋友们在电影院. )

总结关系

表示对前述内容的概括或结论.

  • 常用词汇：
    • 过渡词： in conclusion, to sum up, in summary,overall, in a word, all in all
  • 例句与辨析：
    • In conclusion, the evidence suggests that thepolicy has been effective. ( 总之，证据表明该政策是有效的. )
    • To sum up, we need to focus on three key areas. (总而言之，我们需要关注三个关键领域. )
    • All in all, it was a very successful event. (总的来说，这是一个非常成功的活动. )

让步关系

表示承认某个事实，但提出一个相反或不受其影响的论点.

  • 常用词汇：
    • 连词： although, though, even though, while
    • 介词/短语： despite, in spite of
    • 副词： admittedly, certainly…but…
  • 例句与辨析：
    • Although/Even though it was expensive, we decidedto buy it. ( 尽管它很贵，我们还是决定买下它. )
      • Even though 语气比 Although更强.
    • Despite/In spite of the rain, the game continued. (尽管下雨，比赛还是继续了. )
      • Despite 和 In spite of后接名词或动词的-ing形式.
    • Though I agree with your point, I think we shouldconsider other options. (虽然我同意你的观点，但我认为我们应该考虑其他选择. )
      • Though 比 Although更口语化，还可用在句末：It was hard work. I enjoyed it, though.

使用技巧与注意事项

  1. 位置灵活： 许多逻辑关系词 ( 尤其是副词和过渡词 )在句中的位置很灵活，可以放在句首、句中或句末，通常用逗号隔开.

    • However, the results were inconclusive.
    • The results, however, were inconclusive.
    • The results were inconclusive, however.

  2. 词性决定结构：

    • 连词 用来连接两个分句.
      • 正确： I was tired, so I went to bed.
      • 错误： I was tired. So I went to bed. (在非常正式的写作中，应避免用连词开始一个句子，但在口语和非正式写作中很常见.)
    • 副词/过渡词不能直接连接两个分句，必须用句号或分号隔开.
      • 正确： I was tired. Therefore, I went tobed.
      • 正确： I was tired; therefore, I went tobed.
      • 错误： I was tired, therefore I went tobed.

  3. 避免重复：不要连续使用多个意思相同的逻辑关系词，如 “and also” 或 “buthowever”.

  4. 根据语境选择：同一个逻辑关系可能有多个词表达，但它们的正式程度和细微含义可能不同.多读多练，培养语感.

entry.title: C# Design Patterns-Complete Guide with Code
entry.content:
C# Design Patterns- Complete Guide with Code

I’ll cover the most important design patterns with complete, workingC# examples.

Singleton Pattern

Ensures a class has only one instance and provides a global accesspoint.

Factory Pattern

Creates objects without specifying their exact class.

Observer Pattern

Defines a one-to-many dependency where observers are notified ofstate changes.

Strategy Pattern

Defines a family of algorithms and makes them interchangeable.

Decorator Pattern

Adds new functionality to objects dynamically without altering theirstructure.

Repository Pattern

Mediates between the domain and data mapping layers.

Adapter Pattern

Allows incompatible interfaces to work together.

Builder Pattern

Constructs complex objects step by step.

Dependency Injection Pattern

Implements inversion of control for loose coupling.

Command Pattern

Encapsulates a request as an object, allowing parameterization andqueuing.

Chain of ResponsibilityPattern

Passes requests along a chain of handlers.

Facade Pattern

Provides a simplified interface to a complex subsystem.

Template Method Pattern

Defines the skeleton of an algorithm, letting subclasses overridespecific steps.

State Pattern

Allows an object to change its behavior when its internal statechanges.

Summary

I’ve provided complete, working examples of 14 essential C#design patterns

Creational Patterns:

  1. Singleton - Single instance management
  2. Factory - Object creation without specifying exactclass
  3. Builder - Step-by-step complex objectconstruction

Structural Patterns:

  1. Decorator - Add functionality dynamically
  2. Adapter - Make incompatible interfaces worktogether
  3. Facade - Simplified interface to complexsubsystem

Behavioral Patterns:

  1. Observer - One-to-many notification system
  2. Strategy - Interchangeable algorithms
  3. Command - Encapsulate requests with undo/redo
  4. Chain of Responsibility - Pass requests throughhandler chain
  5. Template Method - Define algorithm skeleton
  6. State - Change behavior based on state

Architectural Patterns:

  1. Repository - Data access abstraction
  2. Dependency Injection - Loose coupling throughIoC

Each example includes complete, runnable code with practical usecases. You can copy any of these directly into your C# projects and runthem. They demonstrate real-world scenarios like payment processing,order management, file conversion, and more!

entry.title: c# 笔记
entry.content:
在 C# 中，协变 ( Covariance ) 和逆变 ( Contravariance )是用于描述泛型接口和委托中类型参数转换关系的概念，它们允许在泛型类型之间进行更灵活的转换.

协变 ( Covariance )

协变允许将派生类型的泛型对象赋值给基类型的泛型对象，使用out 关键字标记类型参数.

适用场景当泛型接口/委托的类型参数仅作为返回值使用时.

示例:

逆变 ( Contravariance )

逆变允许将基类型的泛型对象赋值给派生类型的泛型对象，使用in 关键字标记类型参数.

适用场景当泛型接口/委托的类型参数仅作为输入参数使用时.

示例:

委托中的协变和逆变

C# 中的委托也支持协变和逆变:

关键规则

  • 协变使用 out 关键字，类型参数只能作为返回值
  • 逆变使用 in 关键字，类型参数只能作为输入参数
  • 只有接口和委托支持协变和逆变，类和结构不支持
  • 数组也支持协变，但可能导致运行时错误，应谨慎使用

理解协变和逆变有助于编写更灵活、更通用的代码，特别是在处理集合、事件和委托时非常有用.

C# 反射机制详解 ( 含泛型操作 )

反射的核心概念

反射 ( Reflection ) 是 C# 中一种运行时元数据访问机制，允许程序在不依赖编译时类型信息 的前提下，动态检查、访问和操作类型( 类、接口、结构体等 ) 的成员 ( 字段、属性、方法、构造函数等 ).其本质是通过 System.Reflection 命名空间提供的API，解析程序集 ( Assembly )中存储的类型元数据，实现”动态探测”和”动态操作”.

反射的核心价值
  • 打破封装限制 可访问类的私有成员 (需显式指定访问权限 ).
  • 提升代码灵活性动态创建对象、调用方法，适配多变的业务场景 ( 如插件系统、配置驱动开发).
  • 支撑框架级功能 是序列化/反序列化 ( 如 JSON 解析 )、依赖注入 ( DI ) 、ORM 框架 ( 如 EF Core )、单元测试框架的底层核心技术.

反射的基础操作 ( 非泛型 )

基础反射围绕”获取类型信息 → 操作类型成员”展开，核心入口是System.Type 类 ( 每个类型在内存中对应唯一的Type 对象 ).

获取 Type 对象

获取 Type 对象是反射的第一步，常见方式有 3 种:

方式语法适用场景
typeof() 运算符Type type = typeof(目标类型);已知编译时类型，直接获取
GetType() 方法Type type = 对象实例.GetType();已知对象实例，动态获取其类型
Assembly.GetType()Type type = 程序集对象.GetType(“完整类型名”);已知类型的完整名称 ( 含命名空间 ) ，从指定程序集获取

示例:

查看类型成员信息

通过 Type对象的方法，可获取类型的字段、属性、方法、构造函数等成员信息，返回对应的FieldInfo、PropertyInfo、MethodInfo、ConstructorInfo对象.

核心成员获取方法

方法功能常用重载
GetFields()获取字段GetFields(BindingFlags) : 指定访问权限 ( 如公共/私有、静态/实例)
GetProperties()获取属性同上
GetMethods()获取方法同上 ( 需过滤 Object 继承的方法 )
GetConstructors()获取构造函数同上

BindingFlags 枚举 ( 关键 )

用于筛选成员的访问范围，常用组合:

  • 公共实例成员:BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance
  • 私有实例成员:BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance
  • 公共静态成员:BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static

示例:

动态操作类型成员

获取成员信息 ( 如 FieldInfo、MethodInfo )后，可通过其提供的方法动态操作.

动态创建对象

通过 Activator.CreateInstance() 或ConstructorInfo.Invoke() 实现:

动态访问/修改字段/属性

  • 字段: FieldInfo.GetValue(对象实例) /FieldInfo.SetValue(对象实例, 新值)
  • 属性: PropertyInfo.GetValue(对象实例) /PropertyInfo.SetValue(对象实例, 新值)

示例:

动态调用方法

通过 MethodInfo.Invoke(对象实例, 参数数组)实现，静态方法的第一个参数为 null:

泛型的反射操作 ( 重点 )

泛型的反射比非泛型更复杂，核心是区分”未构造泛型类型”和”构造泛型类型”，并通过特定API 处理类型参数.

泛型的核心概念

概念定义示例
未构造泛型类型 ( Open Generic Type )未指定类型参数的泛型类型，是”模板”List、Dictionary<TKey, TValue>
构造泛型类型 ( Closed Generic Type )已指定具体类型参数的泛型类型，是”可实例化的类型”List、Dictionary<string, int>
泛型方法定义未指定类型参数的泛型方法void Add(T item)
构造泛型方法已指定类型参数的泛型方法void Add(int item)

泛型类型的反射

获取泛型类型

  • 未构造泛型类型: 通过 typeof(泛型类型名<>) 获取 (注意尖括号内的占位符数量与泛型参数数量一致 ).
  • 构造泛型类型: 通过未构造类型.MakeGenericType(类型参数数组) 生成.

示例 ( 以自定义泛型类 GenericDemo<T, U> 为例 ) :

动态创建泛型对象

反射的优缺点与注意事项

优点

  1. 灵活性高动态适配未知类型，支撑插件化、配置驱动等场景.
  2. 通用性强 可编写通用框架 ( 如序列化工具 )，无需针对具体类型编码.
  3. 打破封装 可访问私有成员，方便单元测试或特殊场景 (需谨慎使用 ).

缺点

  1. 性能损耗 反射需解析元数据，比直接调用慢 10~100 倍 (高频场景需缓存 Type、MethodInfo 等对象 ).
  2. 编译时无检查成员名称、参数类型错误仅在运行时抛出异常，增加调试难度.
  3. 破坏封装性访问私有成员可能违反面向对象设计原则，导致代码耦合度升高.

注意事项

  1. 缓存反射对象Type、MethodInfo、PropertyInfo等对象是线程安全的，可缓存复用，减少性能损耗.
  2. 指定 BindingFlags获取非公共成员或静态成员时，必须显式指定BindingFlags，否则会返回 null.
  3. 处理泛型歧义 泛型方法重载时，需通过GetMethod() 的参数类型数组区分，避免获取错误的方法.
  4. 权限控制 部分环境 ( 如沙箱 )可能限制反射访问私有成员，需提前确认权限.

常见应用场景

  1. 序列化/反序列化 如Newtonsoft.Json，通过反射遍历对象成员，将对象转换为 JSON 字符串 ( 或反之).
  2. 依赖注入 ( DI ) 如Autofac、Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection，通过反射创建服务实例，注入到依赖对象中.
  3. ORM 框架 如 EFCore，通过反射映射实体类属性与数据库表字段，生成 SQL 语句.
  4. 插件系统 如 Visual Studio插件，通过反射加载外部程序集，调用插件中的方法.
  5. 单元测试 如xUnit，通过反射调用测试方法，访问私有成员验证内部逻辑.

C# 特性 ( Attribute ) 详解

特性 ( Attribute ) 是 C#中一种强大的元数据机制，允许开发者在代码中嵌入额外信息，这些信息可以在编译时被编译器使用或在运行时通过反射读取.特性为程序提供了一种声明式编程方式，广泛应用于框架开发、代码分析和运行时行为控制.

特性的基本概念

什么是特性

特性是一种特殊的类，继承自System.Attribute，用于为代码元素 ( 类、方法、属性等 )添加元数据.它们不会直接影响代码的执行逻辑，而是通过工具或运行时反射来使用这些元数据.

特性的命名规范

  • 特性类通常以 Attribute 结尾 ( 如ObsoleteAttribute )
  • 应用时可以省略 Attribute 后缀 ( 如[Obsolete] 等价于 [ObsoleteAttribute] )
  • 特性类必须直接或间接继承自 System.Attribute

特性的应用目标

特性可以应用于几乎所有代码元素，包括 : 程序集 ( Assembly ) 、模块 (Module ) 、类 ( Class ) 、结构体 ( Struct ) 、枚举 ( Enum ) 、构造函数 (Constructor ) 、方法 ( Method ) 、属性 ( Property ) 、字段 ( Field )、事件 ( Event ) 、接口 ( Interface ) 、参数 ( Parameter ) 、返回值 (ReturnValue )

AttributeUsage 特性

[AttributeUsage]是一个特殊的特性，用于控制自定义特性的使用规则，它有三个重要参数 :

  1. AttributeTargets 指定特性可以应用到的代码元素

  2. AllowMultiple指定是否允许在同一元素上多次应用该特性

    • true : 允许多次应用
    • false ( 默认 ) : 不允许

  3. Inherited 指定特性是否可以被派生类继承

    • true ( 默认 ) : 可以继承
    • false : 不能继承

常用内置特性

C# 提供了许多内置特性，以下是最常用的几种 :

Obsolete 特性

标记代码元素为过时，编译器会产生警告或错误

Conditional 特性

根据条件编译符号决定是否保留方法调用

Serializable 特性

标记类可以被序列化

Deprecated 特性 ( .NET 5+ )

比 Obsolete 更现代的替代，提供更丰富的废弃信息

程序集特性

应用于整个程序集，通常在 AssemblyInfo.cs 中定义

数据验证特性

在 ASP.NET 等框架中用于模型验证
